  220   # Checks the defined encounters for the current map and returns the encounter
  221   # type that the given time should produce. Only returns an encounter type if
  222   # it has been defined for the current map.
  223   def find_valid_encounter_type_for_time(base_type, time)
  224     ret = nil
  225     if PBDayNight.isDay?(time)
  226       try_type = nil
  227       if PBDayNight.isMorning?(time)
  228         try_type = (base_type.to_s + "Morning").to_sym
  229       elsif PBDayNight.isAfternoon?(time)
  230         try_type = (base_type.to_s + "Afternoon").to_sym
  231       elsif PBDayNight.isEvening?(time)
  232         try_type = (base_type.to_s + "Evening").to_sym
  233       end
  234       ret = try_type if try_type && has_encounter_type?(try_type)
  235       if !ret
  236         try_type = (base_type.to_s + "Day").to_sym
  237         ret = try_type if has_encounter_type?(try_type)
  238       end
  239     else
  240       try_type = (base_type.to_s + "Night").to_sym
  241       ret = try_type if has_encounter_type?(try_type)
  242     end
  243     return ret if ret
  244     return (has_encounter_type?(base_type)) ? base_type : nil
  245   end

  268   # For the current map, randomly chooses a species and level from the encounter
  269   # list for the given encounter type. Returns nil if there are none defined.
  270   # A higher chance_rolls makes this method prefer rarer encounter slots.
  271   def choose_wild_pokemon(enc_type, chance_rolls = 1)
  272     if !enc_type || !GameData::EncounterType.exists?(enc_type)
  273       raise ArgumentError.new(_INTL("Encounter type {1} does not exist", enc_type))
  274     end
  275     enc_list = @encounter_tables[enc_type]
  276     return nil if !enc_list || enc_list.length == 0
  277     # Static/Magnet Pull prefer wild encounters of certain types, if possible.
  278     # If they activate, they remove all Pokémon from the encounter table that do
  279     # not have the type they favor. If none have that type, nothing is changed.
  280     first_pkmn = $player.first_pokemon
  281     if first_pkmn
  282       favored_type = nil
  283       case first_pkmn.ability_id
  284       when :FLASHFIRE
  285         favored_type = :FIRE if Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS &&
  286                                 GameData::Type.exists?(:FIRE) && rand(100) < 50
  287       when :HARVEST
  288         favored_type = :GRASS if Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS &&
  289                                  GameData::Type.exists?(:GRASS) && rand(100) < 50
  290       when :LIGHTNINGROD
  291         favored_type = :ELECTRIC if Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS &&
  292                                     GameData::Type.exists?(:ELECTRIC) && rand(100) < 50
  293       when :MAGNETPULL
  294         favored_type = :STEEL if GameData::Type.exists?(:STEEL) && rand(100) < 50
  295       when :STATIC
  296         favored_type = :ELECTRIC if GameData::Type.exists?(:ELECTRIC) && rand(100) < 50
  297       when :STORMDRAIN
  298         favored_type = :WATER if Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS &&
  299                                  GameData::Type.exists?(:WATER) && rand(100) < 50
  300       end
  301       if favored_type
  302         new_enc_list = []
  303         enc_list.each do |enc|
  304           species_data = GameData::Species.get(enc[1])
  305           new_enc_list.push(enc) if species_data.types.include?(favored_type)
  306         end
  307         enc_list = new_enc_list if new_enc_list.length > 0
  308       end
  309     end
  310     enc_list.sort! { |a, b| b[0] <=> a[0] }   # Highest probability first
  311     # Calculate the total probability value
  312     chance_total = 0
  313     enc_list.each { |a| chance_total += a[0] }
  314     # Choose a random entry in the encounter table based on entry probabilities
  315     rnd = 0
  316     chance_rolls.times do
  317       r = rand(chance_total)
  318       rnd = r if r > rnd   # Prefer rarer entries if rolling repeatedly
  319     end
  320     encounter = nil
  321     enc_list.each do |enc|
  322       rnd -= enc[0]
  323       next if rnd >= 0
  324       encounter = enc
  325       break
  326     end
  327     # Get the chosen species and level
  328     level = rand(encounter[2]..encounter[3])
  329     # Some abilities alter the level of the wild Pokémon
  330     if first_pkmn
  331       case first_pkmn.ability_id
  332       when :HUSTLE, :PRESSURE, :VITALSPIRIT
  333         level = encounter[3] if rand(100) < 50   # Highest possible level
  334       end
  335     end
  336     # Black Flute and White Flute alter the level of the wild Pokémon
  337     if $PokemonMap.lower_level_wild_pokemon
  338       level = [level - rand(1..4), 1].max
  339     elsif $PokemonMap.higher_level_wild_pokemon
  340       level = [level + rand(1..4), GameData::GrowthRate.max_level].min
  341     end
  342     # Return [species, level]
  343     return [encounter[1], level]
  344   end

  380 # Creates and returns a Pokémon based on the given species and level.
  381 # Applies wild Pokémon modifiers (wild held item, shiny chance modifiers,
  382 # Pokérus, gender/nature forcing because of player's lead Pokémon).
  383 def pbGenerateWildPokemon(species, level, isRoamer = false)
  384   genwildpoke = Pokemon.new(species, level)
  385   # Give the wild Pokémon a held item
  386   items = genwildpoke.wildHoldItems
  387   first_pkmn = $player.first_pokemon
  388   chances = [50, 5, 1]
  389   if first_pkmn
  390     case first_pkmn.ability_id
  391     when :COMPOUNDEYES
  392       chances = [60, 20, 5]
  393     when :SUPERLUCK
  394       chances = [60, 20, 5] if Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS
  395     end
  396   end
  397   itemrnd = rand(100)
  398   if (items[0] == items[1] && items[1] == items[2]) || itemrnd < chances[0]
  399     genwildpoke.item = items[0].sample
  400   elsif itemrnd < (chances[0] + chances[1])
  401     genwildpoke.item = items[1].sample
  402   elsif itemrnd < (chances[0] + chances[1] + chances[2])
  403     genwildpoke.item = items[2].sample
  404   end
  405   # Improve chances of shiny Pokémon with Shiny Charm and battling more of the
  406   # same species
  407   shiny_retries = 0
  408   shiny_retries += 2 if $bag.has?(:SHINYCHARM)
  409   if Settings::HIGHER_SHINY_CHANCES_WITH_NUMBER_BATTLED
  410     values = [0, 0]
  411     case $player.pokedex.battled_count(species)
  412     when 0...50    then values = [0, 0]
  413     when 50...100  then values = [1, 15]
  414     when 100...200 then values = [2, 20]
  415     when 200...300 then values = [3, 25]
  416     when 300...500 then values = [4, 30]
  417     else                values = [5, 30]
  418     end
  419     shiny_retries += values[0] if values[1] > 0 && rand(1000) < values[1]
  420   end
  421   if shiny_retries > 0
  422     shiny_retries.times do
  423       break if genwildpoke.shiny?
  424       genwildpoke.shiny = nil   # Make it recalculate shininess
  425       genwildpoke.personalID = rand(2**16) | (rand(2**16) << 16)
  426     end
  427   end
  428   # Give Pokérus
  429   genwildpoke.givePokerus if rand(65_536) < Settings::POKERUS_CHANCE
  430   # Change wild Pokémon's gender/nature depending on the lead party Pokémon's
  431   # ability
  432   if first_pkmn
  433     if first_pkmn.hasAbility?(:CUTECHARM) && !genwildpoke.singleGendered?
  434       if first_pkmn.male?
  435         (rand(3) < 2) ? genwildpoke.makeFemale : genwildpoke.makeMale
  436       elsif first_pkmn.female?
  437         (rand(3) < 2) ? genwildpoke.makeMale : genwildpoke.makeFemale
  438       end
  439     elsif first_pkmn.hasAbility?(:SYNCHRONIZE)
  440       if !isRoamer && (Settings::MORE_ABILITIES_AFFECT_WILD_ENCOUNTERS || (rand(100) < 50))
  441         genwildpoke.nature = first_pkmn.nature
  442       end
  443     end
  444   end
  445   # Trigger events that may alter the generated Pokémon further
  446   genwildpoke.form_simple = genwildpoke.form if MultipleForms.hasFunction?(genwildpoke.species, "getForm")
  447   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_pokemon_created, genwildpoke)
  448   return genwildpoke
  449 end

  451 # Used by fishing rods and Headbutt/Rock Smash/Sweet Scent to generate a wild
  452 # Pokémon (or two if it's Sweet Scent) for a triggered wild encounter.
  453 def pbEncounter(enc_type, only_single = true)
  454   $game_temp.encounter_type = enc_type
  455   encounter1 = $PokemonEncounters.choose_wild_pokemon(enc_type)
  456   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_species_chosen, encounter1)
  457   return false if !encounter1
  458   if !only_single && $PokemonEncounters.have_double_wild_battle?
  459     encounter2 = $PokemonEncounters.choose_wild_pokemon(enc_type)
  460     EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_species_chosen, encounter2)
  461     return false if !encounter2
  462     WildBattle.start(encounter1, encounter2, can_override: true)
  463   else
  464     WildBattle.start(encounter1, can_override: true)
  465   end
  466   $game_temp.encounter_type = nil
  467   $game_temp.force_single_battle = false
  468   return true
  469 end

  115 # Returns whether the given category of encounter contains the actual encounter
  116 # method that will occur in the player's current position.
  117 def pbRoamingMethodAllowed(roamer_method)
  118   enc_type = $PokemonEncounters.encounter_type
  119   type = GameData::EncounterType.get(enc_type).type
  120   case roamer_method
  121   when 0   # Any step-triggered method (except Bug Contest)
  122     return [:land, :cave, :water].include?(type)
  123   when 1   # Walking (except Bug Contest)
  124     return [:land, :cave].include?(type)
  125   when 2   # Surfing
  126     return type == :water
  127   when 3   # Fishing
  128     return type == :fishing
  129   when 4   # Water-based
  130     return [:water, :fishing].include?(type)
  131   end
  132   return false
  133 end

  135 EventHandlers.add(:on_wild_species_chosen, :roaming_pokemon,
  136   proc { |encounter|
  137     $game_temp.roamer_index_for_encounter = nil
  138     next if !encounter
  139     # Give the regular encounter if encountering a roaming Pokémon isn't possible
  140     next if $PokemonGlobal.roamedAlready
  141     next if $PokemonGlobal.partner
  142     next if $game_temp.poke_radar_data
  143     next if rand(100) < 75   # 25% chance of encountering a roaming Pokémon
  144     # Look at each roaming Pokémon in turn and decide whether it's possible to
  145     # encounter it
  146     currentRegion = pbGetCurrentRegion
  147     currentMapName = $game_map.name
  148     possible_roamers = []
  149     Settings::ROAMING_SPECIES.each_with_index do |data, i|
  150       # data = [species, level, Game Switch, roamer method, battle BGM, area maps hash]
  151       next if !GameData::Species.exists?(data[0])
  152       next if data[2] > 0 && !$game_switches[data[2]]   # Isn't roaming
  153       next if $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[i] == true   # Roaming Pokémon has been caught
  154       # Get the roamer's current map
  155       roamerMap = $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[i]
  156       if !roamerMap
  157         mapIDs = pbRoamingAreas(i).keys   # Hash of area patrolled by the roaming Pokémon
  158         next if !mapIDs || mapIDs.length == 0   # No roaming area defined somehow
  159         roamerMap = mapIDs[rand(mapIDs.length)]
  160         $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[i] = roamerMap
  161       end
  162       # If roamer isn't on the current map, check if it's on a map with the same
  163       # name and in the same region
  164       if roamerMap != $game_map.map_id
  165         map_metadata = GameData::MapMetadata.try_get(roamerMap)
  166         next if !map_metadata || !map_metadata.town_map_position ||
  167                 map_metadata.town_map_position[0] != currentRegion
  168         next if pbGetMapNameFromId(roamerMap) != currentMapName
  169       end
  170       # Check whether the roamer's roamer method is currently possible
  171       next if !pbRoamingMethodAllowed(data[3])
  172       # Add this roaming Pokémon to the list of possible roaming Pokémon to encounter
  173       possible_roamers.push([i, data[0], data[1], data[4]])   # [i, species, level, BGM]
  174     end
  175     # No encounterable roaming Pokémon were found, just have the regular encounter
  176     next if possible_roamers.length == 0
  177     # Pick a roaming Pokémon to encounter out of those available
  178     roamer = possible_roamers.sample
  179     $PokemonGlobal.roamEncounter = roamer
  180     $game_temp.roamer_index_for_encounter = roamer[0]
  181     $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleBGM = roamer[3] if roamer[3] && !roamer[3].empty?
  182     $game_temp.force_single_battle = true
  183     encounter[0] = roamer[1]   # Species
  184     encounter[1] = roamer[2]   # Level
  185   }
  186 )

  199 def pbRoamingPokemonBattle(pkmn, level = 1)
  200   # Get the roaming Pokémon to encounter; generate it based on the species and
  201   # level if it doesn't already exist
  202   idxRoamer = $game_temp.roamer_index_for_encounter
  203   if !$PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer] ||
  204      !$PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer].is_a?(Pokemon)
  205     if pkmn.is_a?(Pokemon)
  206       $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer] = pbGenerateWildPokemon(pkmn.species_data.id, pkmn.level, true)
  207     else
  208       $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer] = pbGenerateWildPokemon(pkmn, level, true)
  209     end
  210   end
  211   # Set some battle rules
  212   setBattleRule("single")
  213   setBattleRule("roamerFlees")
  214   # Perform the battle
  215   decision = WildBattle.start_core($PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer])
  216   # Update Roaming Pokémon data based on result of battle
  217   if [1, 4].include?(decision)   # Defeated or caught
  218     $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[idxRoamer]       = true
  219     $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemonCaught[idxRoamer] = (decision == 4)
  220   end
  221   $PokemonGlobal.roamEncounter = nil
  222   $PokemonGlobal.roamedAlready = true
  223   $game_temp.roamer_index_for_encounter = nil
  224   # Used by the Poké Radar to update/break the chain
  225   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_battle_end, pkmn.species_data.id, pkmn.level, decision)
  226   # Return false if the player lost or drew the battle, and true if any other result
  227   return (decision != 2 && decision != 5)
  228 end

   60 def pbPokeRadarHighlightGrass(showmessage = true)
   61   grasses = []   # x, y, ring (0-3 inner to outer), rarity
   62   # Choose 1 random tile from each ring around the player
   63   4.times do |i|
   64     r = rand((i + 1) * 8)
   65     # Get coordinates of randomly chosen tile
   66     x = $game_player.x
   67     y = $game_player.y
   68     if r <= (i + 1) * 2
   69       x = $game_player.x - i - 1 + r
   70       y = $game_player.y - i - 1
   71     elsif r <= ((i + 1) * 6) - 2
   72       x = [$game_player.x + i + 1, $game_player.x - i - 1][r % 2]
   73       y = $game_player.y - i + ((r - 1 - ((i + 1) * 2)) / 2).floor
   74     else
   75       x = $game_player.x - i + r - ((i + 1) * 6)
   76       y = $game_player.y + i + 1
   77     end
   78     # Add tile to grasses array if it's a valid grass tile
   79     next if x < 0 || x >= $game_map.width ||
   80             y < 0 || y >= $game_map.height
   81     terrain = $game_map.terrain_tag(x, y)
   82     next if !terrain.land_wild_encounters || !terrain.shows_grass_rustle
   83     # Choose a rarity for the grass (0=normal, 1=rare, 2=shiny)
   84     s = (rand(100) < 25) ? 1 : 0
   85     if $game_temp.poke_radar_data && $game_temp.poke_radar_data[2] > 0
   86       v = [(65_536 / Settings::SHINY_POKEMON_CHANCE) - ([$game_temp.poke_radar_data[2], 40].min * 200), 200].max
   87       v = (65_536 / v.to_f).ceil
   88       s = 2 if rand(65_536) < v
   89     end
   90     grasses.push([x, y, i, s])
   91   end
   92   if grasses.length == 0
   93     # No shaking grass found, break the chain
   94     pbMessage(_INTL("The grassy patch remained quiet...")) if showmessage
   95     pbPokeRadarCancel
   96   else
   97     # Show grass rustling animations
   98     grasses.each do |grass|
   99       case grass[3]
  100       when 0   # Normal rustle
  101         $scene.spriteset.addUserAnimation(Settings::RUSTLE_NORMAL_ANIMATION_ID, grass[0], grass[1], true, 1)
  102       when 1   # Vigorous rustle
  103         $scene.spriteset.addUserAnimation(Settings::RUSTLE_VIGOROUS_ANIMATION_ID, grass[0], grass[1], true, 1)
  104       when 2   # Shiny rustle
  105         $scene.spriteset.addUserAnimation(Settings::RUSTLE_SHINY_ANIMATION_ID, grass[0], grass[1], true, 1)
  106       end

  113 def pbPokeRadarGetShakingGrass

  117   grasses.each do |i|

  127 def pbPokeRadarGetEncounter(rarity = 0)
  128   # Poké Radar-exclusive encounters can only be found in vigorously-shaking grass
  129   if rarity > 0
  130     # Get all Poké Radar-exclusive encounters for this map
  131     map_id = $game_map.map_id
  132     enc_list = nil
  133     encounter_data = GameData::Encounter.get(map_id, $PokemonGlobal.encounter_version)
  134     if encounter_data && encounter_data.types[:PokeRadar] &&
  135        rand(100) < encounter_data.step_chances[:PokeRadar]
  136       enc_list = encounter_data.types[:PokeRadar]
  137     end
  138     # If there are any exclusives, first have a chance of encountering those
  139     if enc_list && enc_list.length > 0
  140       chance_total = 0
  141       enc_list.each { |a| chance_total += a[0] }
  142       rnd = rand(chance_total)
  143       encounter = nil
  144       enc_list.each do |enc|
  145         rnd -= enc[0]
  146         next if rnd >= 0
  147         encounter = enc
  148         break
  149       end
  150       level = rand(encounter[2]..encounter[3])
  151       return [encounter[1], level]
  152     end
  153   end
  154   # Didn't choose a Poké Radar-exclusive species, choose a regular encounter instead
  155   return $PokemonEncounters.choose_wild_pokemon($PokemonEncounters.encounter_type, rarity + 1)
  156 end

  161 EventHandlers.add(:on_wild_species_chosen, :poke_radar_chain,
  162   proc { |encounter|
  163     if GameData::EncounterType.get($game_temp.encounter_type).type != :land ||
  164        $PokemonGlobal.bicycle || $PokemonGlobal.partner
  165       pbPokeRadarCancel
  166       next
  167     end
  168     ring = pbPokeRadarGetShakingGrass
  169     if ring >= 0   # Encounter triggered by stepping into rustling grass
  170       # Get rarity of shaking grass
  171       rarity = 0   # 0 = rustle, 1 = vigorous rustle, 2 = shiny rustle
  172       $game_temp.poke_radar_data[3].each { |g| rarity = g[3] if g[2] == ring }
  173       if $game_temp.poke_radar_data[2] > 0   # Chain count, i.e. is chaining
  174         chain_chance = 58 + (ring * 10)
  175         chain_chance += [$game_temp.poke_radar_data[2], 40].min / 4   # Chain length
  176         chain_chance += 10 if $game_temp.poke_radar_data[4]   # Previous in chain was caught
  177         if rarity == 2 || rand(100) < chain_chance
  178           # Continue the chain
  179           encounter[0] = $game_temp.poke_radar_data[0]   # Species
  180           encounter[1] = $game_temp.poke_radar_data[1]   # Level
  181           $game_temp.force_single_battle = true
  182         else
  183           # Break the chain, force an encounter with a different species
  184           100.times do
  185             break if encounter && encounter[0] != $game_temp.poke_radar_data[0]
  186             new_encounter = $PokemonEncounters.choose_wild_pokemon($PokemonEncounters.encounter_type)
  187             encounter[0] = new_encounter[0]
  188             encounter[1] = new_encounter[1]
  189           end
  190           if encounter[0] == $game_temp.poke_radar_data[0] && encounter[1] == $game_temp.poke_radar_data[1]
  191             # Chain couldn't be broken somehow; continue it after all
  192             $game_temp.force_single_battle = true
  193           else
  194             pbPokeRadarCancel
  195           end
  196         end
  197       else   # Not chaining; will start one
  198         # Force random wild encounter, vigorous shaking means rarer species
  199         new_encounter = pbPokeRadarGetEncounter(rarity)
  200         encounter[0] = new_encounter[0]
  201         encounter[1] = new_encounter[1]
  202         $game_temp.force_single_battle = true
  203       end
  204     elsif encounter   # Encounter triggered by stepping in non-rustling grass
  205       pbPokeRadarCancel
  206     end
  207   }

   33     when "single", "1v1", "1v2", "2v1", "1v3", "3v1",
   34          "double", "2v2", "2v3", "3v2", "triple", "3v3"
   35       rules["size"] = rule.to_s.downcase
   36     when "canlose"                then rules["canLose"]             = true
   37     when "cannotlose"             then rules["canLose"]             = false
   38     when "canrun"                 then rules["canRun"]              = true
   39     when "cannotrun"              then rules["canRun"]              = false
   40     when "roamerflees"            then rules["roamerFlees"]         = true
   41     when "canswitch"              then rules["canSwitch"]           = true
   42     when "cannotswitch"           then rules["canSwitch"]           = false
   43     when "noexp"                  then rules["expGain"]             = false
   44     when "nomoney"                then rules["moneyGain"]           = false
   45     when "disablepokeballs"       then rules["disablePokeBalls"]    = true
   46     when "forcecatchintoparty"    then rules["forceCatchIntoParty"] = true
   47     when "switchstyle"            then rules["switchStyle"]         = true
   48     when "setstyle"               then rules["switchStyle"]         = false
   49     when "anims"                  then rules["battleAnims"]         = true
   50     when "noanims"                then rules["battleAnims"]         = false
   51     when "terrain"
   52       rules["defaultTerrain"] = GameData::BattleTerrain.try_get(var)&.id
   53     when "weather"

  448   # Used by most trainer events, which can be positioned in such a way that
  449   # multiple trainer events spot the player at once. The extra code in this
  450   # method deals with that case and can cause a double trainer battle instead.
  451   def self.start(*args)
  452     # If there is another NPC trainer who spotted the player at the same time,
  453     # and it is possible to have a double battle (the player has 2+ able Pokémon
  454     # or has a partner trainer), then record this first NPC trainer into
  455     # $game_temp.waiting_trainer and end this method. That second NPC event will
  456     # then trigger and cause the battle to happen against this first trainer and
  457     # themselves.
  458     if !$game_temp.waiting_trainer && pbMapInterpreterRunning? && pbCanDoubleBattle?
  459       thisEvent = pbMapInterpreter.get_self
  460       # Find all other triggered trainer events
  461       triggeredEvents = $game_player.pbTriggeredTrainerEvents([2], false, true)
  462       otherEvent = []
  463       triggeredEvents.each do |i|
  464         next if i.id == thisEvent.id
  465         next if $game_self_switches[[$game_map.map_id, i.id, "A"]]
  466         otherEvent.push(i)
  467       end
  468       # If there is exactly 1 other triggered trainer event, this trainer can be
  469       # stored up to battle with that one
  470       if otherEvent.length == 1
  471         trainers, _items, _end_speeches, _party, _party_starts = TrainerBattle.generate_foes(*args)
  472         # If this is just 1 trainer with 6 or fewer Pokémon, it can be stored up
  473         # to battle alongside the other trainer
  474         if trainers.length == 1 && trainers[0].party.length <= Settings::MAX_PARTY_SIZE
  475           $game_temp.waiting_trainer = [trainers[0], thisEvent.id]
  476           return false
  477         end
  478       end
  479     end
  480     # Perform the battle
  481     if $game_temp.waiting_trainer
  482       new_args = args + [$game_temp.waiting_trainer[0]]
  483       outcome = TrainerBattle.start_core(*new_args)
  484       pbMapInterpreter.pbSetSelfSwitch($game_temp.waiting_trainer[1], "A", true) if outcome == 1

  486     else
  487       outcome = TrainerBattle.start_core(*args)
  488     end
  489     # Return true if the player won the battle, and false if any other result
  490     return outcome == 1
  491   end

  707   :DESTINYKNOT    # Levels                                                               91-100

  712 # Try to gain an item after a battle if a Pokemon has the ability Pickup.
  713 def pbPickup(pkmn)
  714   return if pkmn.egg? || !pkmn.hasAbility?(:PICKUP)
  715   return if pkmn.hasItem?
  716   return unless rand(100) < 10   # 10% chance for Pickup to trigger
  717   num_rarity_levels = 10
  718   # Ensure common and rare item lists contain defined items
  719   common_items = pbDynamicItemList(*PICKUP_COMMON_ITEMS)
  720   rare_items = pbDynamicItemList(*PICKUP_RARE_ITEMS)
  721   return if common_items.length < num_rarity_levels - 1 + PICKUP_COMMON_ITEM_CHANCES.length
  722   return if rare_items.length < num_rarity_levels - 1 + PICKUP_RARE_ITEM_CHANCES.length
  723   # Determine the starting point for adding items from the above arrays into the
  724   # pool
  725   start_index = [([100, pkmn.level].min - 1) * num_rarity_levels / 100, 0].max
  726   # Generate a pool of items depending on the Pokémon's level
  727   items = []
  728   PICKUP_COMMON_ITEM_CHANCES.length.times { |i| items.push(common_items[start_index + i]) }
  729   PICKUP_RARE_ITEM_CHANCES.length.times { |i| items.push(rare_items[start_index + i]) }
  730   # Randomly choose an item from the pool to give to the Pokémon
  731   all_chances = PICKUP_COMMON_ITEM_CHANCES + PICKUP_RARE_ITEM_CHANCES
  732   rnd = rand(all_chances.sum)
  733   cumul = 0
  734   all_chances.each_with_index do |c, i|
  735     cumul += c
  736     next if rnd >= cumul
  737     pkmn.item = items[i]
  738     break
  739   end
  740 end

  742 # Try to gain a Honey item after a battle if a Pokemon has the ability Honey Gather.
  743 def pbHoneyGather(pkmn)
  744   return if !GameData::Item.exists?(:HONEY)
  745   return if pkmn.egg? || !pkmn.hasAbility?(:HONEYGATHER) || pkmn.hasItem?
  746   chance = 5 + (((pkmn.level - 1) / 10) * 5)
  747   return unless rand(100) < chance

  118 def pbSafariBattle(pkmn, level = 1)
  119   # Generate a wild Pokémon based on the species and level
  120   pkmn = pbGenerateWildPokemon(pkmn, level) if !pkmn.is_a?(Pokemon)
  121   foeParty = [pkmn]
  122   # Calculate who the trainer is
  123   playerTrainer = $player
  124   # Create the battle scene (the visual side of it)
  125   scene = BattleCreationHelperMethods.create_battle_scene
  126   # Create the battle class (the mechanics side of it)
  127   battle = SafariBattle.new(scene, playerTrainer, foeParty)
  128   battle.ballCount = pbSafariState.ballcount
  129   BattleCreationHelperMethods.prepare_battle(battle)
  130   # Perform the battle itself
  131   decision = 0
  132   pbBattleAnimation(pbGetWildBattleBGM(foeParty), 0, foeParty) do
  133     pbSceneStandby { decision = battle.pbStartBattle }
  134   end
  135   Input.update
  136   # Update Safari game data based on result of battle
  137   pbSafariState.ballcount = battle.ballCount
  138   if pbSafariState.ballcount <= 0
  139     if decision != 2   # Last Safari Ball was used to catch the wild Pokémon
  140       pbMessage(_INTL("Announcer: You're out of Safari Balls! Game over!"))
  141     end
  142     pbSafariState.decision = 1
  143     pbSafariState.pbGoToStart
  144   end
  145   # Save the result of the battle in Game Variable 1
  146   #    0 - Undecided or aborted
  147   #    2 - Player ran out of Safari Balls
  148   #    3 - Player or wild Pokémon ran from battle, or player forfeited the match
  149   #    4 - Wild Pokémon was caught
  150   if decision == 4
  151     $stats.safari_pokemon_caught += 1
  152     pbSafariState.captures += 1
  153     $stats.most_captures_per_safari_game = [$stats.most_captures_per_safari_game, pbSafariState.captures].max
  154   end
  155   pbSet(1, decision)
  156   # Used by the Poké Radar to update/break the chain
  157   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_battle_end, pkmn.species_data.id, pkmn.level, decision)

  430       catch_rate = pkmn.species_data.catch_rate
  431       catchFactor  = (catch_rate * 100) / 1275
  432       catchFactor  = [[catchFactor, 3].max, 20].min
  433       escapeFactor = (pbEscapeRate(catch_rate) * 100) / 1275
  434       escapeFactor = [[escapeFactor, 2].max, 20].min

  466           @decision = 3

  477             @decision = 2

  264 # Returns a score for this Pokemon in the Bug-Catching Contest.
  265 # Not exactly the HGSS calculation, but it should be decent enough.
  266 def pbBugContestScore(pkmn)
  267   levelscore = pkmn.level * 4
  268   ivscore = 0
  269   pkmn.iv.each_value { |iv| ivscore += iv.to_f / Pokemon::IV_STAT_LIMIT }
  270   ivscore = (ivscore * 100).floor
  271   hpscore = (100.0 * pkmn.hp / pkmn.totalhp).floor
  272   catch_rate = pkmn.species_data.catch_rate
  273   rarescore = 60
  274   rarescore += 20 if catch_rate <= 120
  275   rarescore += 20 if catch_rate <= 60
  276   return levelscore + ivscore + hpscore + rarescore
  277 end

  361 def pbBugContestBattle(pkmn, level = 1)
  362   # Record information about party Pokémon to be used at the end of battle (e.g.
  363   # comparing levels for an evolution check)
  364   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_start_battle)
  365   # Generate a wild Pokémon based on the species and level
  366   pkmn = pbGenerateWildPokemon(pkmn, level) if !pkmn.is_a?(Pokemon)
  367   foeParty = [pkmn]
  368   # Calculate who the trainers and their party are
  369   playerTrainer     = [$player]
  370   playerParty       = $player.party
  371   playerPartyStarts = [0]
  372   # Create the battle scene (the visual side of it)
  373   scene = BattleCreationHelperMethods.create_battle_scene
  374   # Create the battle class (the mechanics side of it)
  375   battle = BugContestBattle.new(scene, playerParty, foeParty, playerTrainer, nil)
  376   battle.party1starts = playerPartyStarts
  377   battle.ballCount    = pbBugContestState.ballcount
  378   setBattleRule("single")
  379   BattleCreationHelperMethods.prepare_battle(battle)
  380   # Perform the battle itself
  381   decision = 0
  382   pbBattleAnimation(pbGetWildBattleBGM(foeParty), 0, foeParty) do
  383     decision = battle.pbStartBattle
  384     BattleCreationHelperMethods.after_battle(decision, true)
  385     if [2, 5].include?(decision)   # Lost or drew
  386       $game_system.bgm_unpause
  387       $game_system.bgs_unpause
  388       pbBugContestStartOver
  389     end
  390   end
  391   Input.update
  392   # Update Bug Contest game data based on result of battle
  393   pbBugContestState.ballcount = battle.ballCount
  394   if pbBugContestState.ballcount == 0
  395     pbMessage(_INTL("ANNOUNCER:  The Bug-Catching Contest is over!"))
  396     pbBugContestState.pbStartJudging
  397   end
  398   # Save the result of the battle in Game Variable 1
  399   BattleCreationHelperMethods.set_outcome(decision, 1)
  400   # Used by the Poké Radar to update/break the chain
  401   EventHandlers.trigger(:on_wild_battle_end, pkmn.species_data.id, pkmn.level, decision)
  402   # Return false if the player lost or drew the battle, and true if any other result
  403   return (decision != 2 && decision != 5)
  404 end

  191 #===============================================================================
  192 # Return a level value based on Pokémon in a party
  193 #===============================================================================
  194 def pbBalancedLevel(party)
  195   return 1 if party.length == 0
  196   # Calculate the mean of all levels
  197   sum = 0
  198   party.each { |p| sum += p.level }
  199   return 1 if sum == 0
  200   mLevel = GameData::GrowthRate.max_level
  201   average = sum.to_f / party.length
  202   # Calculate the standard deviation
  203   varianceTimesN = 0
  204   party.each do |pkmn|
  205     deviation = pkmn.level - average
  206     varianceTimesN += deviation * deviation
  207   end
  208   # NOTE: This is the "population" standard deviation calculation, since no
  209   # sample is being taken.
  210   stdev = Math.sqrt(varianceTimesN / party.length)
  211   mean = 0
  212   weights = []
  213   # Skew weights according to standard deviation
  214   party.each do |pkmn|
  215     weight = pkmn.level.to_f / sum
  216     if weight < 0.5
  217       weight -= (stdev / mLevel.to_f)
  218       weight = 0.001 if weight <= 0.001
  219     else
  220       weight += (stdev / mLevel.to_f)
  221       weight = 0.999 if weight >= 0.999
  222     end
  223     weights.push(weight)
  224   end
  225   weightSum = 0
  226   weights.each { |w| weightSum += w }
  227   # Calculate the weighted mean, assigning each weight to each level's
  228   # contribution to the sum
  229   party.each_with_index { |pkmn, i| mean += pkmn.level * weights[i] }
  230   mean /= weightSum
  231   mean = mean.round
  232   mean = 1 if mean < 1
  233   # Add 2 to the mean to challenge the player
  234   mean += 2
  235   # Adjust level to maximum
  236   mean = mLevel if mean > mLevel
  237   return mean
  238 end

    1 # 野外被动变化与失败回程（净化正文；批次 8）
    2 
    3 分类：Pokémon Rules（主）；Generic Kernel（步数/时间/持久）、Engine/Overworld Integration（地图/步进/帧钩子/转移）、User Interface（消息/菜单/调试）、Demo/Developer Experience（编译模板与事件编排证据）。本文件固定野外被动效果与失败回程的规则合同——哪些入口计步、计什么、按什么次序产生什么效果、病毒如何随日期推进、失能后按什么顺序回到哪里。全部内容为静态证据；**无运行确认**（见 `../scope-statement.md`）。
    4 
    5 ## 1. 目的与范围
    6 
    7 **范围**：① 触发、计数与效果次序；② 行走友好度；③ 野外中毒与全队失能；④ Pokérus 状态与日期推进；⑤ 治疗点、治疗与失败回程；⑥ 集成、持久、开发者入口与证据边界。
    8 
    9 **非目标**：不定义普通遭遇算法、友好度数值全集、战斗终局/钱款/资源结算、场地招式与道具合同全集、寄养/育种/孵化合同、Shadow/净化合同、漫游/雷达合同、Safari/捕虫合同（各归主规格）；不展开地图事件编排/治疗点解释/费用话术——只能按实际可读证据登记（U01/demo 规格）；脚本提供入口不等于默认事件确实调用。
   10 
   11 **已通过边界（继承，不重开）**：GR-011／GR-013；WP37（漫游/雷达）；WP53（Safari/捕虫——捕虫分流按当前合同引用，不重新推断其计数/治疗/判奖）；战斗终局、败/平、钱款与资源合同；普通遭遇与 Repel 门；友好度数值；时间/场地与回程工具；Shadow/净化（各归其规格）。
   12 
   13 ## 2. 概念与术语
   14 
   15 - **步进入口四分**：**普通玩家迈步**（玩家完成一步）；**强制路线/事件解释器移动**（玩家处于强制路线或地图解释器运行中完成移动——**步后入口发一般迈步通知并返回，不计全局步数/玩家周期/遭遇；实际完成移动先已通知，完整前提下合计两次（§3.1）**）；**原地转向**（可判定遭遇但不计步）；**地图帧更新**（每帧一次，含微更新路径，WP53 已证暂停命令循环链）。**GR-011（已关闭）**的入口差别保持：步进、转向、主动请求是不同入口，主动请求包装本身不写遭遇触发标记。
   16 - **全局步数（持久于全局元数据）**：仅在普通玩家迈步时 +1（31 位回绕）；**计数初始化**：首次迈步前惰性为 0。各消费者读自己关心的周期（友好周期 128、毒伤周期 4）；**不因消费者重置全局步数**（友好度用的是独立计数 `happinessSteps`，§4）。
   17 - **共享转移处理状态（handled）**：当步消费者顺序共享是否已处理转移的状态；任一消费者置真后，后续按该门跳过且不再判定当步遭遇。不规定单槽数组或其它容器实现；毒伤当前成员循环的有界继续规则仍见§5.2。
   18 - **三类目的地状态（互相独立、不是同一份状态）**：**最近中心记录**（`pokecenterMapId/X/Y/Direction`——由接待/中心事件写入；证据为**公开入口存在＋编译侧对既有中心事件的识别谓词**——**识别 ≠ 构造**：不为事件插入中心记录调用、也不是生成模板（§7.1），demo 编排 U01）；**场地回程目的地**（`healingSpot`——进入带回程目的地元数据的地图时**覆盖写入**，由 Teleport 消费、**使用后不清空**）；**洞穴逃脱点**（`escapePoint`——洞穴入口写入、洞穴出口/逃脱类入口**使用后清空**；失败回程**仅到达普通末尾的路径清空**——家图缺失提前返回与捕虫分流不经此步（§7.1/§7.2））；**角色/全局家地点**（角色元数据 `home` 与全局元数据 `home`——静态数据，Teleport 与失败回程的回退）。
   19 - **Pokérus 编码（个体字段，独立数学）**：单整数字段——**菌株 S＝高 4 位（⌊字段/16⌋），剩余期限 T＝低 4 位（字段 mod 16）**；**阶段**：字段＝0 → 未感染；T>0 → 感染期（1）；T＝0 且 S>0 → 已治愈（2）。**期限由菌株决定：T＝1＋(S mod 4)**（1–4 天）。
   20 - **持久 ≠ 已落盘**：全局元数据随存档保存（《保存、启动、新游戏与继续》）；`stepcount`、`happinessSteps`、`pokerusTime`、三类地点、统计、开关的持久归属见 §8；运行时刻值（帧计时器、倒计时）与落盘分开。
   21 
   22 ## 3. 触发、计数与效果次序
   23 
   24 ### 3.1 步进入口与全局计数
   25 
   26 - **普通玩家迈步（正常分支，按序）**：①全局步数初始化（首次为 0）并 +1（31 位回绕）；②读 Repel 激活态（计数 >0——遭遇规格门输入）；③触发玩家步进通知；④触发可转移步进通知（共享handled状态）；⑤**handled 为真 → 本步结束（不再判定遭遇）**；⑥事件未触发且不在菜单 → 判定遭遇（无可战成员/无遭遇可能/无类型/触发判定未过即返回；通过后选择遭遇、触发遭遇选择通知、允许门、双打门、公开开战（可覆盖）；最后写遭遇类型清空、遭遇触发标记、强制单打复位——遭遇规格主责）。
   27 - **强制路线/事件解释器移动（早退分支）**：玩家处于强制路线或地图解释器运行中完成移动——**只触发迈步通知（携带玩家）并返回**——**不计全局步数、不发玩家步进/可转移通知、不判定遭遇**。地形效果钩子（煤烟拾取/草丛摇动/瀑布冰面自动移动）在此分支照常收到通知。
   28 - **原地转向**：可判定遭遇（同一遭遇判定入口——遭遇规格），**不计步**；转向清理与步进清理不同（GR-011 已关闭合同，继承）。
   29 - **任意事件完成一步**：触发迈步通知（携带该事件）——煤烟（任何移动者擦除第一煤烟层；只有玩家持袋且未达上限时增加资源/统计）、草丛摇动动画（地图场景内的占用格）、瀑布/冰面自动移动（仅玩家）。
   30 - **帧更新**：每帧一次（含暂停微更新链——WP53 已证部分，不重开）。
   31 
   32 **完成移动的组合调用（不把入口孤立计一次）**：一般角色移动完成先发一般步进通知，随后玩家步后检测才进入上述分支。正常地图场景、无冰面/瀑布自动移动、实际平移完成、未中断或转移、强制路线仍有效且后续等待使它保持有效（或解释器仍运行）时：先一般通知，再步后入口第二次一般通知并返回；全局步数、玩家周期均不推进。两煤烟层、玩家持袋且煤烟≤9997时可擦两层、资源/统计+2。普通完成步为一次一般通知后玩家链/全局+1；NPC完成步只有一次一般通知；直接调用步后入口只有其一次，不能冒充实际移动的两次。自动地形、中断、路线已结束或其它字段改写须另给前提。
   33 
   34 ### 3.2 各通知的消费者次序（事件分发合同）
   35 
   36 - **帧更新**：Pokérus 日期检查 → 低电量警告 → 延迟 BGM → **电话计时（门：玩家持有 Pokégear、不在菜单/战斗/消息窗、非强制路线/解释器；刷新可战联系人、下次来电倒计时（≤0 重置为 **20–39 整分钟（40 不含）**随机、按帧递减）、到 0 生成来电——注册 ≠ 必然产生效果；电话合同未归本文件，仅登记次序与门）** → 捕虫倒计时（WP53 主责）。
   37 - **迈步通知（任意事件）**：煤烟拾取 → 草丛摇动 → 瀑布/冰面自动移动 → **冲浪跳跃收尾（门：地图场景＋事件是玩家＋有冲浪临时底座坐标：清底座；正在结束冲浪时取消载具、重置遭遇步数、播地图 BGM、清结束标记——世界时间场地规格主责引用）**。
   38 - **玩家步进通知**：行走友好度 → 寄养步进处理（寄养规格主责）→ Repel 计数（§3.3）→ 雷达电量（WP37 主责）→ **Shadow 心灵量表与净化室（两个层级分列）：①**队伍成员计数门**——对可战成员逐个处理，**心量表非零才进入计数**（为零跳过；人工负值同样进入计数，与「大于 0」门不同，不能据此臆造量表下降）；计数 +1、到 256 执行步行心量变化（量表变化仍引用 Shadow 规格）、阶段归零做净化就绪检查、阶段变化更新 Shadow 招式、计数归零；②**净化室更新是对象存在门**——位于成员循环结束之后、按净化室对象是否存在调用其更新（自身组级效果门仍引用 Shadow 规格），**不要求队伍里有正心量表成员、也不等待 256 步**——队伍全为普通可战个体（无 Shadow）但净化室已存在且室内组满足 Shadow 规格推进条件时，普通玩家步进仍调用净化室更新（FP24 对照）** → 孵化步数（孵化规格主责）。
   39 - **可转移步进通知（handled 串联）**：野外中毒（§5）→ Safari 计步（WP53 主责）。
   40 - **换图**：新图设置（回程目的地覆盖写入、地图容器清空、遭遇表重建、已访问记录）→ 天气（世界时间场地规格主责）→ 足迹 → 强制骑行 → 漫游推进（WP37）→ 雷达取消（WP37）→ Safari 清空（WP53）→ 捕虫清理（WP53）。
   41 - **地图/精灵集变更**：暗度精灵、位置窗 → 捕虫定时器（WP53）。
   42 - **每个消费者仍由原规格主责**——本文件只登记次序与门，**不在本文件再算一遍同一步**。
   43 
   44 **煤烟状态与收集门分开**：每次一般步进通知读取该移动者所在真实格，按图层2→1→0找首个煤烟层，擦除该层后停止。NPC、玩家无袋也擦除，无资源/统计；玩家持SOOTSACK时资源夹在0…9999，统计只加实际正增量。9999时仍擦除但资源/统计+0；低于上限一次+1。此规则按通知次数应用，不按孤立“玩家一步”假定只一次（§3.1）。
   45 
   46 **低电量警告门与临时会话**：必须放电中，且满足（剩余秒数非空并≤600）或（电量百分比非空并≤15）之一；当前临时状态尚未警告，且不在菜单/战斗/消息窗、非强制路线、解释器未运行才继续。先置已警告状态，再请求消息；门阻止时不置状态。同一临时状态中充电后再放电也不重复，新的临时状态可能再次提示；仅脚本文本检索未见其它重置，不能扩张为插件/宿主保证。10%放电时菜单阻止而仍未警告，退出菜单首个合格帧置状态并请求一次；次帧不再请求。
   47 
   48 ### 3.3 Repel 计数的步进侧事实
   49 
   50 - **写入**：Repel 道具（道具规格主责）——已激活时拒绝（效果仍在）、否则播放音效、统计 +1、按档位写入步数（100/200/250）。
   51 - **步进递减（玩家步进通知）**：计数 ≤0 或玩家在冰面 → 不计；否则 −1；**减到 0**：背包无 Repel 旗标道具 →「效果消失」消息并结束；**有** → 确认「再用一个？」——确认则打开按 Repel 旗标过滤的背包选择屏，选定即使用该道具（消耗链回道具规格）。
   52 - **遭遇门输入**：`repel > 0` 只是遭遇规格遭遇门（允许门：野生等级低于队首（可战）成员等级则拒绝并清累积——遭遇规格主规格，本文件不重算）。
   53 
   54 ## 4. 行走友好度
   55 
   56 ### 4.1 步数累计与周期门
   57 
   58 - **独立计数（`happinessSteps`，持久于全局元数据）**：普通迈步时初始化（首次为 0）并 +1；**未达 128 即返回**；**到 128** → 对**全体可战成员**（非空、非蛋、未濒死——可战队伍集合）**逐个以 1/2 概率**（0..1 均匀整数为 0 才生效）**执行一次步行类别的友好变化**（**数值、获得地/豪华球/安抚铃修正与封顶只引用成长规格**，本文件不复制一套数学）；随后**计数重置为 0**。
   59 - **空/全不合资格队伍**：队伍无可战成员（全蛋/全濒死/空）→ 循环无对象，**计数仍重置为 0**（周期正常消耗）；有事件触发不等于自动进行进化检查（进化检查归战斗/升级入口，战斗结果/《基础进化》引用；实际调用未证的部分不补成保证）。
   60 - **资格与限制（逐项）**：**蛋**（非可战成员——不参与）；**濒死**（同上——不参与）；**Shadow**（友好变化覆写：**Shadow 个体且心灵阶段 ≥4 时不产生友好变化**——Shadow 规格主责，本文件引用）；**正值修正与封顶消费**（获得地一致 +1、豪华球 +1、安抚铃 ×1.5 取整、软顶配置开启时封顶到 179 以下——**默认软顶关闭**（配置值），成长规格/《规则配置档案与数据变体》引用）。
   61 
   62 ### 4.2 与步行相关的其它友好写入口（边界引用）
   63 
   64 - **濒死（「faint」）**：野外中毒濒死时写入（§5）；**负值修正不受正值加成**——数值引用成长规格。
   65 - **未知方法**：未登记的方法名在变化入口报错（防御性边界，成长规格引用）。
   66 
   67 ## 5. 野外中毒与全队失能
   68 
   69 ### 5.1 默认设置与配置变体
   70 
   71 - **默认（机制世代 8）**：`POISON_IN_FIELD` 为**假**（世代 ≤4 才为真）——**默认不发生野外毒伤**（钩子第二门直接跳过）；`POISON_FAINT_IN_FIELD` 为**假**（世代 ≤3 才为真）——即使开启野外毒伤，**默认 HP 到 1 即清毒、不在野外濒死**。
   72 - **配置变体（两个独立开关组合）**：野外毒伤开关（≤4 世代语义）× 野外濒死开关（≤3 世代语义）——四种组合按两个配置分别登记（不把「更代」当作单一开关）。

  658   def compile_encounters(*paths)
  659     GameData::Encounter::DATA.clear
  660     max_level = GameData::GrowthRate.max_level
  661     paths.each do |path|
  662       compile_pbs_file_message_start(path)
  663       file_suffix = File.basename(path, ".txt")[GameData::Encounter::PBS_BASE_FILENAME.length + 1, path.length] || ""
  664       encounter_hash = nil
  665       step_chances   = nil
  666       current_type   = nil
  667       idx = 0
  668       pbCompilerEachPreppedLine(path) do |line, line_no|
  669         echo "." if idx % 100 == 0
  670         idx += 1
  671         Graphics.update if idx % 500 == 0
  672         next if line.length == 0
  673         if current_type && line[/^\d+,/]   # Species line
  674           values = line.split(",").collect! { |v| v.strip }
  675           if !values || values.length < 3
  676             raise _INTL("Expected a species entry line for encounter type {1} for map {2}.",
  677                         GameData::EncounterType.get(current_type).real_name, encounter_hash[:map]) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  678           end
  679           values = get_csv_record(line, [nil, "vevV", nil, :Species])
  680           values[3] = values[2] if !values[3]
  681           if values[2] > max_level
  682             raise _INTL("Level number {1} is not valid (max. {2}).", values[2], max_level) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  683           elsif values[3] > max_level
  684             raise _INTL("Level number {1} is not valid (max. {2}).", values[3], max_level) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  685           elsif values[2] > values[3]
  686             raise _INTL("Minimum level is greater than maximum level.") + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  687           end
  688           encounter_hash[:types][current_type].push(values)
  689         elsif line[/^\[\s*(.+)\s*\]$/]   # Map ID line
  690           values = $~[1].split(",").collect! { |v| v.strip.to_i }
  691           values[1] = 0 if !values[1]
  692           map_number = values[0]
  693           map_version = values[1]
  694           # Add map encounter's data to records
  695           if encounter_hash
  696             encounter_hash[:types].each_value do |slots|
  697               next if !slots || slots.length == 0
  698               slots.each_with_index do |slot, i|
  699                 next if !slot
  700                 slots.each_with_index do |other_slot, j|
  701                   next if i == j || !other_slot
  702                   next if slot[1] != other_slot[1] || slot[2] != other_slot[2] || slot[3] != other_slot[3]
  703                   slot[0] += other_slot[0]
  704                   slots[j] = nil
  705                 end
  706               end
  707               slots.compact!
  708               slots.sort! { |a, b| (a[0] == b[0]) ? a[1].to_s <=> b[1].to_s : b[0] <=> a[0] }
  709             end
  710             GameData::Encounter.register(encounter_hash)
  711           end
  712           # Raise an error if a map/version combo is used twice
  713           key = sprintf("%s_%d", map_number, map_version).to_sym
  714           if GameData::Encounter::DATA[key]
  715             raise _INTL("Encounters for map '{1}' are defined twice.", map_number) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  716           end
  717           step_chances = {}
  718           # Construct encounter hash
  719           encounter_hash = {
  720             :id              => key,
  721             :map             => map_number,
  722             :version         => map_version,
  723             :step_chances    => step_chances,
  724             :types           => {},
  725             :pbs_file_suffix => file_suffix
  726           }
  727           current_type = nil
  728         elsif !encounter_hash   # File began with something other than a map ID line
  729           raise _INTL("Expected a map number, got \"{1}\" instead.", line) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  730         else
  731           # Check if line is an encounter method name or not
  732           values = line.split(",").collect! { |v| v.strip }
  733           current_type = (values[0] && !values[0].empty?) ? values[0].to_sym : nil
  734           if current_type && GameData::EncounterType.exists?(current_type)   # Start of a new encounter method
  735             step_chances[current_type] = values[1].to_i if values[1] && !values[1].empty?
  736             step_chances[current_type] ||= GameData::EncounterType.get(current_type).trigger_chance
  737             encounter_hash[:types][current_type] = []
  738           else
  739             raise _INTL("Undefined encounter type \"{1}\" for map '{2}'.", line, encounter_hash[:map]) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
  740           end
  741         end
  742       end
  743       # Add last map's encounter data to records
  744       if encounter_hash
  745         encounter_hash[:types].each_value do |slots|
  746           next if !slots || slots.length == 0
  747           slots.each_with_index do |slot, i|
  748             next if !slot
  749             slots.each_with_index do |other_slot, j|
  750               next if i == j || !other_slot
  751               next if slot[1] != other_slot[1] || slot[2] != other_slot[2] || slot[3] != other_slot[3]
  752               slot[0] += other_slot[0]
  753               slots[j] = nil
  754             end
  755           end
  756           slots.compact!
  757           slots.sort! { |a, b| (a[0] == b[0]) ? a[1].to_s <=> b[1].to_s : b[0] <=> a[0] }
  758         end
  759         GameData::Encounter.register(encounter_hash)
  760       end
  761       process_pbs_file_message_end
  762     end
  763     # Save all data
  764     GameData::Encounter.save

  461 def pbDebugRoamers
  462   viewport = Viewport.new(0, 0, Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
  463   viewport.z = 99999
  464   sprites = {}
  465   sprites["cmdwindow"] = SpriteWindow_DebugRoamers.new(viewport)
  466   cmdwindow = sprites["cmdwindow"]
  467   cmdwindow.active = true
  468   loop do
  469     Graphics.update
  470     Input.update
  471     pbUpdateSpriteHash(sprites)
  472     if cmdwindow.index < cmdwindow.roamerCount
  473       pkmn = Settings::ROAMING_SPECIES[cmdwindow.index]
  474     else
  475       pkmn = nil
  476     end
  477     if Input.trigger?(Input::ACTION) && cmdwindow.index < cmdwindow.roamerCount &&
  478        (pkmn[2] <= 0 || $game_switches[pkmn[2]]) &&
  479        $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[cmdwindow.index] != true
  480       # Roam selected Pokémon
  481       pbPlayDecisionSE
  482       if Input.press?(Input::CTRL)   # Roam to current map
  483         if $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index] == pbDefaultMap
  484           $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index] = nil
  485         else
  486           $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index] = pbDefaultMap
  487         end
  488       else   # Roam to a random other map
  489         oldmap = $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index]
  490         pbRoamPokemonOne(cmdwindow.index)
  491         if $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index] == oldmap
  492           $PokemonGlobal.roamPosition[cmdwindow.index] = nil
  493           pbRoamPokemonOne(cmdwindow.index)
  494         end
  495         $PokemonGlobal.roamedAlready = false
  496       end
  497       cmdwindow.refresh
  498     elsif Input.trigger?(Input::BACK)
  499       pbPlayCancelSE
  500       break
  501     elsif Input.trigger?(Input::USE)
  502       if cmdwindow.index < cmdwindow.roamerCount
  503         pbPlayDecisionSE
  504         # Toggle through roaming, not roaming, defeated
  505         if pkmn[2] > 0 && !$game_switches[pkmn[2]]
  506           # not roaming -> roaming
  507           $game_switches[pkmn[2]] = true
  508         elsif $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[cmdwindow.index] != true
  509           # roaming -> defeated
  510           $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[cmdwindow.index] = true
  511           $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemonCaught[cmdwindow.index] = false
  512         elsif $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[cmdwindow.index] == true &&
  513               !$PokemonGlobal.roamPokemonCaught[cmdwindow.index]
  514           # defeated -> caught
  515           $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemonCaught[cmdwindow.index] = true
  516         elsif pkmn[2] > 0
  517           # caught -> not roaming (or roaming if Switch ID is 0)
  518           $game_switches[pkmn[2]] = false if pkmn[2] > 0
  519           $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemon[cmdwindow.index] = nil
  520           $PokemonGlobal.roamPokemonCaught[cmdwindow.index] = false
  521         end
  522         cmdwindow.refresh
  523       elsif cmdwindow.index == cmdwindow.itemCount - 2   # All roam
  524         if Settings::ROAMING_SPECIES.length == 0
  525           pbPlayBuzzerSE
  526         else
  527           pbPlayDecisionSE
  528           pbRoamPokemon
  529           $PokemonGlobal.roamedAlready = false
  530           cmdwindow.refresh
  531         end
  532       else   # Clear all roaming locations

  539           end
  540           $PokemonGlobal.roamedAlready = false
  541           cmdwindow.refresh
  542         end
  543       end

   19       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
   20       pbCall(b.index)
   21     end
   22   end
   23 
   24   def pbPursuit(idxSwitcher)
   25     @switching = true
   26     pbPriority.each do |b|
   27       next if b.fainted? || !b.opposes?(idxSwitcher)   # Shouldn't hit an ally
   28       next if b.movedThisRound? || !pbChoseMoveFunctionCode?(b.index, "PursueSwitchingFoe")
   29       # Check whether Pursuit can be used
   30       next unless pbMoveCanTarget?(b.index, idxSwitcher, @choices[b.index][2].pbTarget(b))
   31       next unless pbCanChooseMove?(b.index, @choices[b.index][1], false)
   32       next if b.status == :SLEEP || b.status == :FROZEN
   33       next if b.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
   34       next if b.hasActiveAbility?(:TRUANT) && b.effects[PBEffects::Truant]
   35       # Mega Evolve
   36       if !b.wild?
   37         owner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(b.index)
   38         pbMegaEvolve(b.index) if @megaEvolution[b.idxOwnSide][owner] == b.index
   39       end
   40       # Use Pursuit
   41       @choices[b.index][3] = idxSwitcher   # Change Pursuit's target
   42       b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index], false)
   43       break if @decision > 0 || @battlers[idxSwitcher].fainted?
   44     end
   45     @switching = false
   46   end
   47 
   48   def pbAttackPhaseSwitch
   49     pbPriority.each do |b|
   50       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :SwitchOut && !b.fainted?
   51       idxNewPkmn = @choices[b.index][1]   # Party index of Pokémon to switch to
   52       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
   53       @lastMoveUser = b.index
   54       # Switching message
   55       pbMessageOnRecall(b)
   56       # Pursuit interrupts switching
   57       pbPursuit(b.index)
   58       return if @decision > 0
   59       # Switch Pokémon
   60       allBattlers.each do |b2|
   61         b2.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
   62         b2.statsDropped = false
   63       end
   64       pbRecallAndReplace(b.index, idxNewPkmn)
   65       pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b.index, true)
   66     end
   67   end
   68 
   69   def pbAttackPhaseItems
   70     pbPriority.each do |b|
   71       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseItem && !b.fainted?
   72       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
   73       item = @choices[b.index][1]
   74       next if !item
   75       case GameData::Item.get(item).battle_use
   76       when 1, 2   # Use on Pokémon/Pokémon's move
   77         pbUseItemOnPokemon(item, @choices[b.index][2], b) if @choices[b.index][2] >= 0
   78       when 3      # Use on battler
   79         pbUseItemOnBattler(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
   80       when 4      # Use Poké Ball
   81         pbUsePokeBallInBattle(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
   82       when 5      # Use directly
   83         pbUseItemInBattle(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
   84       else
   85         next
   86       end
   87       return if @decision > 0
   88     end
   89     pbCalculatePriority if Settings::RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES
   90   end

   92   def pbAttackPhaseMegaEvolution
   93     pbPriority.each do |b|
   94       next if b.wild?
   95       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove && !b.fainted?
   96       owner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(b.index)
   97       next if @megaEvolution[b.idxOwnSide][owner] != b.index
   98       pbMegaEvolve(b.index)

    1 #===============================================================================
    2 # This module stores events that can happen during the game. A procedure can
    3 # subscribe to an event by adding itself to the event. It will then be called
    4 # whenever the event occurs. Existing events are:
    5 #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    6 #   :on_game_map_setup - When a Game_Map is set up. Typically changes map data.
    7 #   :on_new_spriteset_map - When a Spriteset_Map is created. Adds more things to
    8 #     show in the overworld.
    9 #   :on_frame_update - Once per frame. Various frame/time counters.
   10 #   :on_leave_map - When leaving a map. End weather/expired effects.
   11 #   :on_enter_map - Upon entering a new map. Set up new effects, end expired
   12 #     effects.
   13 #   :on_map_or_spriteset_change - Upon entering a new map or when spriteset was
   14 #     made. Show things on-screen.
   15 #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   16 #   :on_player_change_direction - When the player turns in a different direction.
   17 #   :on_leave_tile - When any event or the player starts to move from a tile.
   18 #   :on_step_taken - When any event or the player finishes a step.
   19 #   :on_player_step_taken - When the player finishes a step/ends surfing, except
   20 #     as part of a move route. Step-based counters.
   21 #   :on_player_step_taken_can_transfer - When the player finishes a step/ends
   22 #     surfing, except as part of a move route. Step-based effects that can
   23 #     transfer the player elsewhere.
   24 #   :on_player_interact - When the player presses the Use button in the
   25 #     overworld.
   26 #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   27 #   :on_trainer_load - When an NPCTrainer is generated (to battle against or as
   28 #     a registered partner). Various modifications to that trainer and their
   29 #     Pokémon.
   30 #   :on_wild_species_chosen - When a species/level have been chosen for a wild
   31 #     encounter. Changes the species/level (e.g. roamer, Poké Radar chain).
   32 #   :on_wild_pokemon_created - When a Pokemon object has been created for a wild
   33 #     encounter. Various modifications to that Pokémon.
   34 #   :on_calling_wild_battle - When a wild battle is called. Prevents that wild
   35 #     battle and instead starts a different kind of battle (e.g. Safari Zone).
   36 #   :on_start_battle - Just before a battle starts. Memorize/reset information
   37 #     about party Pokémon, which is used after battle for evolution checks.
   38 #   :on_end_battle - Just after a battle ends. Evolution checks, Pickup/Honey
   39 #     Gather, blacking out.
   40 #   :on_wild_battle_end - After a wild battle. Updates Poké Radar chain info.
   41 #===============================================================================
   42 module EventHandlers
   43   @@events = {}
   44 
   45   # Add a named callback for the given event.
   46   def self.add(event, key, proc)
   47     @@events[event] = NamedEvent.new if !@@events.has_key?(event)
   48     @@events[event].add(key, proc)
   49   end
   50 
   51   # Remove a named callback from the given event.
   52   def self.remove(event, key)
   53     @@events[event]&.remove(key)
   54   end
   55 
   56   # Clear all callbacks for the given event.
   57   def self.clear(key)
   58     @@events[key]&.clear
   59   end
   60 
   61   # Trigger all callbacks from an Event if it has been defined.
   62   def self.trigger(event, *args)
   63     return @@events[event]&.trigger(*args)
   64   end
   65 end

   67 #===============================================================================
   68 # This module stores the contents of various menus. Each command in a menu is a
   69 # hash of data (containing its name, relative order, code to run when chosen,
   70 # etc.).
   71 # Menus that use this module are:
   72 #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   73 # Pause menu
   74 # Party screen main interact menu
   75 # Pokégear main menu
   76 # Options screen
   77 # PC main menu
   78 # Various debug menus (main, Pokémon, battle, battle Pokémon)
   79 #===============================================================================
   80 module MenuHandlers
   81   @@handlers = {}
   82 
   83   def self.add(menu, option, hash)
   84     @@handlers[menu] = HandlerHash.new if !@@handlers.has_key?(menu)
   85     @@handlers[menu].add(option, hash)

  429 def pbMoveTutorAnnotations(move, movelist = nil)
  430   ret = []
  431   $player.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
  432     if pkmn.egg?

  436     else

  439         # Checked data from movelist given in parameter
  440         ret[i] = _INTL("ABLE")
  441       elsif pkmn.compatible_with_move?(move)
  442         # Checked data from Pokémon's tutor moves in pokemon.txt
  443         ret[i] = _INTL("ABLE")

  452 def pbMoveTutorChoose(move, movelist = nil, bymachine = false, oneusemachine = false)
  453   ret = false
  454   move = GameData::Move.get(move).id
  455   if movelist.is_a?(Array)
  456     movelist.map! { |m| GameData::Move.get(m).id }
  457   end
  458   pbFadeOutIn do
  459     movename = GameData::Move.get(move).name
  460     annot = pbMoveTutorAnnotations(move, movelist)
  461     scene = PokemonParty_Scene.new
  462     screen = PokemonPartyScreen.new(scene, $player.party)
  463     screen.pbStartScene(_INTL("Teach which Pokémon?"), false, annot)
  464     loop do
  465       chosen = screen.pbChoosePokemon
  466       break if chosen < 0
  467       pokemon = $player.party[chosen]
  468       if pokemon.egg?
  469         pbMessage(_INTL("Eggs can't be taught any moves.")) { screen.pbUpdate }
  470       elsif pokemon.shadowPokemon?
  471         pbMessage(_INTL("Shadow Pokémon can't be taught any moves.")) { screen.pbUpdate }
  472       elsif movelist && movelist.none? { |j| j == pokemon.species }
  473         pbMessage(_INTL("{1} can't learn {2}.", pokemon.name, movename)) { screen.pbUpdate }
  474       elsif !pokemon.compatible_with_move?(move)
  475         pbMessage(_INTL("{1} can't learn {2}.", pokemon.name, movename)) { screen.pbUpdate }

  690   def get_csv_record(rec, schema)
  691     ret = []
  692     repeat = false
  693     start = 0
  694     schema_length = schema[1].length
  695     case schema[1][0, 1]   # First character in schema
  696     when "*"
  697       repeat = true
  698       start = 1
  699     when "^"
  700       start = 1
  701       schema_length -= 1
  702     end
  703     subarrays = repeat && schema[1].length - start > 1   # Whether ret is an array of arrays
  704     # Split the string on commas into an array of values to apply the schema to
  705     values = split_csv_line(rec)
  706     # Apply the schema to each value in the line
  707     idx = -1   # Index of value to look at in values
  708     loop do
  709       record = []
  710       (start...schema[1].length).each do |i|
  711         idx += 1
  712         sche = schema[1][i, 1]
  713         if sche[/[A-Z]/]   # Upper case = optional
  714           if nil_or_empty?(values[idx])
  715             record.push(nil)
  716             next
  717           end
  718         end
  719         if sche.downcase == "q"   # Unformatted text
  720           record.push(rec)
  721           idx = values.length
  722           break
  723         else
  724           record.push(cast_csv_value(values[idx], sche, schema[2 + i - start]))
  725         end
  726       end
  727       if !record.empty?
  728         if subarrays
  729           ret.push(record)
  730         else
  731           ret.concat(record)
  732         end
  733       end
  734       break if !repeat || idx >= values.length - 1
  735     end
  736     return (!repeat && schema_length == 1) ? ret[0] : ret
  737   end

  742   def pbWriteCsvRecord(record, file, schema)
  743     rec = (record.is_a?(Array)) ? record.flatten : [record]
  744     start = (["*", "^"].include?(schema[1][0, 1])) ? 1 : 0
  745     index = -1
  746     loop do
  747       (start...schema[1].length).each do |i|
  748         index += 1
  749         value = rec[index]
  750         if schema[1][i, 1][/[A-Z]/]   # Optional
  751           # Check the rest of the values for non-nil things
  752           later_value_found = false
  753           (index...rec.length).each do |j|
  754             later_value_found = true if !rec[j].nil?
  755             break if later_value_found
  756           end
  757           if !later_value_found
  758             start = -1
  759             break
  760           end
  761         end
  762         file.write(",") if index > 0
  763         next if value.nil?

    1 # The SaveData module is used to manipulate save data. It contains the {Value}s
    2 # that make up the save data and {Conversion}s for resolving incompatibilities
    3 # between Essentials and game versions.
    4 # @see SaveData.register
    5 # @see SaveData.register_conversion
    6 module SaveData
    7   # Contains the file path of the save file.
    8   FILE_PATH = if File.directory?(System.data_directory)
    9                 System.data_directory + "/Game.rxdata"
   10               else
   11                 "./Game.rxdata"
   12               end
   13 
   14   # @return [Boolean] whether the save file exists
   15   def self.exists?
   16     return File.file?(FILE_PATH)
   17   end
   18 
   19   # Fetches the save data from the given file.
   20   # Returns an Array in the case of a pre-v19 save file.
   21   # @param file_path [String] path of the file to load from
   22   # @return [Hash, Array] loaded save data
   23   # @raise [IOError, SystemCallError] if file opening fails
   24   def self.get_data_from_file(file_path)
   25     validate file_path => String
   26     save_data = nil
   27     File.open(file_path) do |file|
   28       data = Marshal.load(file)
   29       if data.is_a?(Hash)
   30         save_data = data
   31         next
   32       end
   33       save_data = [data]
   34       save_data << Marshal.load(file) until file.eof?
   35     end
   36     return save_data
   37   end
   38 
   39   # Fetches save data from the given file. If it needed converting, resaves it.
   40   # @param file_path [String] path of the file to read from
   41   # @return [Hash] save data in Hash format
   42   # @raise (see .get_data_from_file)
   43   def self.read_from_file(file_path)
   44     validate file_path => String
   45     save_data = get_data_from_file(file_path)
   46     save_data = to_hash_format(save_data) if save_data.is_a?(Array)
   47     if !save_data.empty? && run_conversions(save_data)
   48       File.open(file_path, "wb") { |file| Marshal.dump(save_data, file) }
   49     end
   50     return save_data
   51   end
   52 
   53   # Compiles the save data and saves a marshaled version of it into
   54   # the given file.
   55   # @param file_path [String] path of the file to save into
   56   # @raise [InvalidValueError] if an invalid value is being saved
   57   def self.save_to_file(file_path)
   58     validate file_path => String
   59     save_data = self.compile_save_hash
   60     File.open(file_path, "wb") { |file| Marshal.dump(save_data, file) }
   61   end
   62 
   63   # Deletes the save file (and a possible .bak backup file if one exists)
   64   # @raise [Error::ENOENT]
   65   def self.delete_file

   68   end

   70   # Converts the pre-v19 format data to the new format.
   71   # @param old_format [Array] pre-v19 format save data
   72   # @return [Hash] save data in new format
   73   def self.to_hash_format(old_format)
   74     validate old_format => Array
   75     hash = {}
   76     @values.each do |value|
   77       data = value.get_from_old_format(old_format)
   78       hash[value.id] = data unless data.nil?
   79     end

    1 module SaveData
    2   # Contains Conversion objects for each defined conversion:
    3   # {
    4   #   :essentials => {
    5   #     '19'    => [<Conversion>, ...],
    6   #     '19.1'  => [<Conversion>, ...],
    7   #     ...
    8   #   },
    9   #   :game => {
   10   #     '1.1.0' => [<Conversion>, ...],
   11   #     '1.2.0' => [<Conversion>, ...],
   12   #     ...
   13   #   }
   14   # }
   15   # Populated during runtime by SaveData.register_conversion calls.
   16   @conversions = {
   17     essentials: {},
   18     game:       {}
   19   }
   20 
   21   #=============================================================================
   22   # Represents a conversion made to save data.
   23   # New conversions are added using {SaveData.register_conversion}.
   24   class Conversion
   25     # @return [Symbol] conversion ID
   26     attr_reader :id
   27     # @return [String] conversion title
   28     attr_reader :title
   29     # @return [Symbol] trigger type of the conversion (+:essentials+ or +:game+)
   30     attr_reader :trigger_type
   31     # @return [String] trigger version of the conversion
   32     attr_reader :version
   33 
   34     # @param id [String] conversion ID
   35     def initialize(id, &block)
   36       @id = id
   37       @value_procs = {}
   38       @all_proc = nil
   39       @title = "Running conversion #{@id}"
   40       @trigger_type = nil
   41       @version = nil
   42       instance_eval(&block)
   43       if @trigger_type.nil? || @version.nil?
   44         raise "Conversion #{@id} is missing a condition"
   45       end
   46     end
   47 
   48     # Returns whether the conversion should be run with the given version.
   49     # @param version [String] version to check
   50     # @return [Boolean] whether the conversion should be run
   51     def should_run?(version)
   52       return PluginManager.compare_versions(version, @version) < 0
   53     end
   54 
   55     # Runs the conversion on the given save data.
   56     # @param save_data [Hash]
   57     def run(save_data)
   58       @value_procs.each do |value_id, proc|
   59         unless save_data.has_key?(value_id)
   60           raise "Save data does not have value #{value_id.inspect}"
   61         end
   62         proc.call(save_data[value_id])
   63       end
   64       @all_proc.call(save_data) if @all_proc.is_a?(Proc)
   65     end
   66 
   67     # Runs the conversion on the given object.
   68     # @param object
   69     # @param key [Symbol]
   70     def run_single(object, key)
   71       @value_procs[key].call(object) if @value_procs[key].is_a?(Proc)
   72     end
   73 
   74     #---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   75 
   76     private
   77 
   78     # @!group Configuration
   79 
   80     # Sets the conversion's title.
   81     # @param new_title [String] conversion title
   82     # @note Since conversions are run before loading the player's chosen language,
   83     #   conversion titles can not be localized.
   84     # @see SaveData.register_conversion
   85     def display_title(new_title)
   86       validate new_title => String
   87       @title = new_title
   88     end
   89 
   90     # Sets the conversion to trigger for save files created below
   91     # the given Essentials version.
   92     # @param version [Numeric, String]
   93     # @see SaveData.register_conversion
   94     def essentials_version(version)
   95       validate version => [Numeric, String]
   96       raise "Multiple conditions in conversion #{@id}" unless @version.nil?
   97       @trigger_type = :essentials
   98       @version = version.to_s
   99     end
  100 
  101     # Sets the conversion to trigger for save files created below
  102     # the given game version.
  103     # @param version [Numeric, String]
  104     # @see SaveData.register_conversion
  105     def game_version(version)
  106       validate version => [Numeric, String]
  107       raise "Multiple conditions in conversion #{@id}" unless @version.nil?
  108       @trigger_type = :game
  109       @version = version.to_s
  110     end
  111 
  112     # Defines a conversion to the given save value.
  113     # @param value_id [Symbol] save value ID
  114     # @see SaveData.register_conversion
  115     def to_value(value_id, &block)
  116       validate value_id => Symbol
  117       raise ArgumentError, "No block given to to_value" unless block_given?
  118       if @value_procs[value_id].is_a?(Proc)
  119         raise "Multiple to_value definitions in conversion #{@id} for #{value_id}"
  120       end
  121       @value_procs[value_id] = block
  122     end
  123 
  124     # Defines a conversion to the entire save data.
  125     # @see SaveData.register_conversion
  126     def to_all(&block)
  127       raise ArgumentError, "No block given to to_all" unless block_given?
  128       if @all_proc.is_a?(Proc)
  129         raise "Multiple to_all definitions in conversion #{@id}"
  130       end
  131       @all_proc = block
  132     end
  133 
  134     # @!endgroup
  135   end
  136 
  137   #=============================================================================
  138   # Registers a {Conversion} to occur for save data that meets the given criteria.
  139   # Two types of criteria can be defined: {Conversion#essentials_version} and
  140   # {Conversion#game_version}. The conversion is automatically run on save data
  141   # that contains an older version number.
  142   #
  143   # A single value can be modified with {Conversion#to_value}. The entire save data
  144   # is accessed with {Conversion#to_all}, and a conversion title can be specified
  145   # with {Conversion#display_title}.
  146   # @example Registering a new conversion
  147   #   SaveData.register_conversion(:my_conversion) do
  148   #     game_version '1.1.0'
  149   #     display_title 'Converting some stuff'
  150   #     to_value :player do |player|
  151   #       # code that modifies the :player value
  152   #     end
  153   #     to_all do |save_data|
  154   #       save_data[:new_value] = Foo.new
  155   #     end
  156   #   end
  157   # @yield the block of code to be saved as a Conversion
  158   def self.register_conversion(id, &block)
  159     validate id => Symbol
  160     unless block_given?
  161       raise ArgumentError, "No block given to SaveData.register_conversion"
  162     end
  163     conversion = Conversion.new(id, &block)
  164     @conversions[conversion.trigger_type][conversion.version] ||= []
  165     @conversions[conversion.trigger_type][conversion.version] << conversion
  166   end
  167 
  168   # @param save_data [Hash] save data to get conversions for
  169   # @return [Array<Conversion>] all conversions that should be run on the data
  170   def self.get_conversions(save_data)
  171     conversions_to_run = []
  172     versions = {
  173       essentials: save_data[:essentials_version] || "18.1",
  174       game:       save_data[:game_version] || "0.0.0"
  175     }
  176     [:essentials, :game].each do |trigger_type|
  177       # Ensure the versions are sorted from lowest to highest
  178       sorted_versions = @conversions[trigger_type].keys.sort do |v1, v2|
  179         PluginManager.compare_versions(v1, v2)
  180       end
  181       sorted_versions.each do |version|
  182         @conversions[trigger_type][version].each do |conversion|
  183           next unless conversion.should_run?(versions[trigger_type])
  184           conversions_to_run << conversion
  185         end
  186       end
  187     end
  188     return conversions_to_run
  189   end
  190 
  191   # Runs all possible conversions on the given save data.
  192   # Saves a backup before running conversions.
  193   # @param save_data [Hash] save data to run conversions on
  194   # @return [Boolean] whether conversions were run
  195   def self.run_conversions(save_data)
  196     validate save_data => Hash
  197     conversions_to_run = self.get_conversions(save_data)
  198     return false if conversions_to_run.none?
  199     File.open(SaveData::FILE_PATH + ".bak", "wb") { |f| Marshal.dump(save_data, f) }
  200     Console.echo_h1(_INTL("Converting save file"))
  201     conversions_to_run.each do |conversion|
  202       Console.echo_li("#{conversion.title}...")
  203       conversion.run(save_data)
  204       Console.echo_done(true)
  205     end
  206     Console.echoln_li_done(_INTL("Successfully applied {1} save file conversion(s)", conversions_to_run.length))
  207     save_data[:essentials_version] = Essentials::VERSION
  208     save_data[:game_version] = Settings::GAME_VERSION
  209     return true
  210   end
  211 
  212   # Runs all possible conversions on the given object.
  213   # @param object [Hash] object to run conversions on
  214   # @param key [Hash] object's key in save data
  215   # @param save_data [Hash] save data to run conversions on
  216   def self.run_single_conversions(object, key, save_data)
  217     validate key => Symbol
  218     conversions_to_run = self.get_conversions(save_data)
  219     conversions_to_run.each do |conversion|
  220       conversion.run_single(object, key)
  221     end
  222   end
  223 end

  940       gain = [10, 5, 2][happiness_range]
  941     when "vitamin"

  944       gain = [3, 2, 1][happiness_range]
  945     when "machine", "battleitem"
  946       gain = [1, 1, 0][happiness_range]

  949     when "faintbad"   # Fainted against an opponent that is 30+ levels higher
  950       gain = [-5, -5, -10][happiness_range]

  953     when "energyroot"

  113   def pbReducePP(move)
  114     return true if usingMultiTurnAttack?
  115     return true if move.pp < 0          # Don't reduce PP for special calls of moves
  116     return true if move.total_pp <= 0   # Infinite PP, can always be used
  117     return false if move.pp == 0        # Ran out of PP, couldn't reduce
  118     pbSetPP(move, move.pp - 1) if move.pp > 0
  119     return true
  120   end

  511         return [1]
  512       when 2   # 1v2

  111   # This method is how each Pokémon is compiled from the PBS files listing
  112   # Battle Tower/Cup Pokémon.
  113   def self.fromInspected(str)
  114     insp = str.gsub(/^\s+/, "").gsub(/\s+$/, "")
  115     pieces = insp.split(/\s*;\s*/)
  116     species = (GameData::Species.exists?(pieces[0])) ? GameData::Species.get(pieces[0]).id : nil
  117     item = (GameData::Item.exists?(pieces[1])) ? GameData::Item.get(pieces[1]).id : nil
  118     nature = (GameData::Nature.exists?(pieces[2])) ? GameData::Nature.get(pieces[2]).id : nil
  119     ev = pieces[3].split(/\s*,\s*/)
  120     ev_array = []
  121     ev.each do |stat|
  122       case stat.upcase
  123       when "HP"          then ev_array.push(:HP)
  124       when "ATK"         then ev_array.push(:ATTACK)
  125       when "DEF"         then ev_array.push(:DEFENSE)
  126       when "SA", "SPATK" then ev_array.push(:SPECIAL_ATTACK)
  127       when "SD", "SPDEF" then ev_array.push(:SPECIAL_DEFENSE)
  128       when "SPD"         then ev_array.push(:SPEED)
  129       end
  130     end
  131     moves = pieces[4].split(/\s*,\s*/)
  132     moveid = []
  133     Pokemon::MAX_MOVES.times do |i|
  134       move_data = GameData::Move.try_get(moves[i])
  135       moveid.push(move_data.id) if move_data
  136     end
  137     moveid.push(GameData::Move.keys.first) if moveid.length == 0   # Get any one move
  138     return self.new(species, item, nature, moveid[0], moveid[1], moveid[2], moveid[3], ev_array)
  139   end
  140 
  141   def self.fromPokemon(pkmn)
  142     mov1 = (pkmn.moves[0]) ? pkmn.moves[0].id : nil
  143     mov2 = (pkmn.moves[1]) ? pkmn.moves[1].id : nil
  144     mov3 = (pkmn.moves[2]) ? pkmn.moves[2].id : nil
  145     mov4 = (pkmn.moves[3]) ? pkmn.moves[3].id : nil
  146     ev_array = []
  147     GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
  148       ev_array.push(s.id) if pkmn.ev[s.id] > 60
  149     end
  150     return self.new(pkmn.species, pkmn.item_id, pkmn.nature,
  151                     mov1, mov2, mov3, mov4, ev_array)
  152   end

  154   def initialize(species, item, nature, move1, move2, move3, move4, ev)
  155     @species = species

  160     @move2   = move2
  161     @move3   = move3
  162     @move4   = move4
  163     @ev      = ev

  337   # Compares two versions given in string form. v1 should be the plugin version
  338   # you actually have, and v2 should be the minimum/desired plugin version.
  339   # Return values:
  340   #     1 if v1 is higher than v2
  341   #     0 if v1 is equal to v2
  342   #     -1 if v1 is lower than v2
  343   def self.compare_versions(v1, v2)
  344     d1 = v1.chars
  345     d1.insert(0, "0") if d1[0] == "."   # Turn ".123" into "0.123"
  346     while d1[-1] == "."                 # Turn "123." into "123"
  347       d1 = d1[0..-2]
  348     end
  349     d2 = v2.chars
  350     d2.insert(0, "0") if d2[0] == "."   # Turn ".123" into "0.123"
  351     while d2[-1] == "."                 # Turn "123." into "123"
  352       d2 = d2[0..-2]
  353     end
  354     [d1.size, d2.size].max.times do |i|   # Compare each digit in turn
  355       c1 = d1[i]
  356       c2 = d2[i]
  357       if c1
  358         return 1 if !c2
  359         return 1 if c1.to_i(16) > c2.to_i(16)
  360         return -1 if c1.to_i(16) < c2.to_i(16)
  361       elsif c2
  362         return -1
  363       end
  364     end
  365     return 0
  366   end

  543     # Move battlers around if none are near to each other
  544     # NOTE: This code assumes each side has a maximum of 3 battlers on it, and
  545     #       is not generalised to larger side sizes.
  546     if !singleBattle?
  547       swaps = []   # Each element is an array of two battler indices to swap

  549         next if pbSideSize(side) == 1   # Only battlers on sides of size 2+ need to move
  550         # Check if any battler on this side is near any battler on the other side
  551         anyNear = false
  552         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
  553           anyNear = allOtherSideBattlers(battler).any? { |other| nearBattlers?(other.index, battler.index) }
  554           break if anyNear
  555         end
  556         break if anyNear
  557         # No battlers on this side are near any battlers on the other side; try
  558         # to move them
  559         # NOTE: If we get to here (assuming both sides are of size 3 or less),
  560         #       there is definitely only 1 able battler on this side, so we
  561         #       don't need to worry about multiple battlers trying to move into
  562         #       the same position. If you add support for a side of size 4+,
  563         #       this code will need revising to account for that, as well as to

  566         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
  567           # Get the position to move to

  569           case pbSideSize(side)
  570           when 2 then pos = [2, 3, 0, 1][battler.index]   # The unoccupied position
