   21     def generate(mother, father)
   22       # Determine which Pokémon is the mother and which is the father
   23       # Ensure mother is female, if the pair contains a female
   24       # Ensure father is male, if the pair contains a male
   25       # Ensure father is genderless, if the pair is a genderless with Ditto
   26       if mother.male? || father.female? || mother.genderless?
   27         mother, father = father, mother
   28       end
   29       mother_data = [mother, mother.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)]
   30       father_data = [father, father.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)]
   31       # Determine which parent the egg's species is based from
   32       species_parent = (mother_data[1]) ? father : mother
   33       # Determine the egg's species
   34       baby_species = determine_egg_species(species_parent.species, mother, father)
   35       mother_data.push(mother.species_data.breeding_can_produce?(baby_species))
   36       father_data.push(father.species_data.breeding_can_produce?(baby_species))
   37       # Generate egg
   38       egg = generate_basic_egg(baby_species)
   39       # Inherit properties from parent(s)
   40       inherit_form(egg, species_parent, mother_data, father_data)
   41       inherit_nature(egg, mother, father)
   42       inherit_ability(egg, mother_data, father_data)
   43       inherit_moves(egg, mother_data, father_data)
   44       inherit_IVs(egg, mother, father)
   45       inherit_poke_ball(egg, mother_data, father_data)
   46       # Calculate other properties of the egg
   47       set_shininess(egg, mother, father)   # Masuda method and Shiny Charm
   48       set_pokerus(egg)
   49       # Recalculate egg's stats
   50       egg.calc_stats
   51       return egg
   52     end

   54     def determine_egg_species(parent_species, mother, father)
   55       ret = GameData::Species.get(parent_species).get_baby_species(true, mother.item_id, father.item_id)
   56       # Check for alternate offspring (i.e. Nidoran M/F, Volbeat/Illumise, Manaphy/Phione)
   57       offspring = GameData::Species.get(ret).offspring
   58       ret = offspring.sample if offspring.length > 0
   59       return ret
   60     end
   61 
   62     def generate_basic_egg(species)
   63       egg = Pokemon.new(species, Settings::EGG_LEVEL)
   64       egg.name           = _INTL("Egg")
   65       egg.steps_to_hatch = egg.species_data.hatch_steps
   66       egg.obtain_text    = _INTL("Day-Care Couple")
   67       egg.happiness      = 120
   68       egg.form           = 0 if species == :SINISTEA
   69       # Set regional form
   70       new_form = MultipleForms.call("getFormOnEggCreation", egg)
   71       egg.form = new_form if new_form
   72       return egg
   73     end
   74 
   75     def inherit_form(egg, species_parent, mother, father)
   76       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
   77       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
   78       # Inherit form from the parent that determined the egg's species
   79       if species_parent.species_data.has_flag?("InheritFormFromMother")
   80         egg.form = species_parent.form
   81       end
   82       # Inherit form from a parent holding an Ever Stone
   83       [mother, father].each do |parent|
   84         next if !parent[2]   # Parent isn't a related species to the egg
   85         next if !parent[0].species_data.has_flag?("InheritFormWithEverStone")
   86         next if !parent[0].hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
   87         egg.form = parent[0].form
   88         break
   89       end
   90     end
   91 
   92     def get_moves_to_inherit(egg, mother, father)
   93       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
   94       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
   95       move_father = (father[1]) ? mother[0] : father[0]
   96       move_mother = (father[1]) ? father[0] : mother[0]
   97       moves = []
   98       # Get level-up moves known by both parents
   99       egg.getMoveList.each do |move|
  100         next if move[0] <= egg.level   # Could already know this move by default
  101         next if !mother[0].hasMove?(move[1]) || !father[0].hasMove?(move[1])
  102         moves.push(move[1])
  103       end
  104       # Inherit Machine moves from father (or non-Ditto genderless parent)
  105       if Settings::BREEDING_CAN_INHERIT_MACHINE_MOVES && !move_father.female?
  106         GameData::Item.each do |i|
  107           move = i.move
  108           next if !move
  109           next if !move_father.hasMove?(move) || !egg.compatible_with_move?(move)
  110           moves.push(move)
  111         end
  112       end
  113       # Inherit egg moves from each parent
  114       if !move_father.female?
  115         egg.species_data.egg_moves.each do |move|
  116           moves.push(move) if move_father.hasMove?(move)
  117         end
  118       end
  119       if Settings::BREEDING_CAN_INHERIT_EGG_MOVES_FROM_MOTHER && move_mother.female?
  120         egg.species_data.egg_moves.each do |move|
  121           moves.push(move) if move_mother.hasMove?(move)
  122         end
  123       end
  124       # Learn Volt Tackle if a parent has a Light Ball and is in the Pichu family
  125       if egg.species == :PICHU && GameData::Move.exists?(:VOLTTACKLE) &&
  126          ((father[2] && father[0].hasItem?(:LIGHTBALL)) ||
  127           (mother[2] && mother[0].hasItem?(:LIGHTBALL)))
  128         moves.push(:VOLTTACKLE)
  129       end
  130       return moves
  131     end
  132 
  133     def inherit_moves(egg, mother, father)
  134       moves = get_moves_to_inherit(egg, mother, father)
  135       # Remove duplicates (keeping the latest ones)
  136       moves = moves.reverse
  137       moves |= []   # remove duplicates
  138       moves = moves.reverse
  139       # Learn moves
  140       first_move_index = moves.length - Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
  141       first_move_index = 0 if first_move_index < 0
  142       (first_move_index...moves.length).each { |i| egg.learn_move(moves[i]) }
  143     end
  144 
  145     def inherit_nature(egg, mother, father)
  146       new_natures = []
  147       new_natures.push(mother.nature) if mother.hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
  148       new_natures.push(father.nature) if father.hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
  149       return if new_natures.empty?
  150       egg.nature = new_natures.sample
  151     end
  152 
  153     # The female parent (or the non-Ditto parent) can pass down its Hidden
  154     # Ability (60% chance) or its regular ability (80% chance).
  155     # NOTE: This is how ability inheritance works in Gen 6+. Gen 5 is more
  156     #       restrictive, and even works differently between BW and B2W2, and I
  157     #       don't think that is worth adding in. Gen 4 and lower don't have
  158     #       ability inheritance at all, and again, I'm not bothering to add that
  159     #       in.
  160     def inherit_ability(egg, mother, father)
  161       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
  162       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
  163       parent = (mother[1]) ? father[0] : mother[0]   # The female or non-Ditto parent
  164       if parent.hasHiddenAbility?
  165         egg.ability_index = parent.ability_index if rand(100) < 60
  166       elsif rand(100) < 80
  167         egg.ability_index = parent.ability_index
  168       else
  169         egg.ability_index = (parent.ability_index + 1) % 2
  170       end
  171     end
  172 
  173     def inherit_IVs(egg, mother, father)
  174       # Get all stats
  175       stats = []
  176       GameData::Stat.each_main { |s| stats.push(s.id) }
  177       # Get the number of stats to inherit (includes ones inherited via Power items)
  178       inherit_count = 3
  179       if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
  180         inherit_count = 5 if mother.hasItem?(:DESTINYKNOT) || father.hasItem?(:DESTINYKNOT)
  181       end
  182       # Inherit IV because of Power items (if both parents have the same Power
  183       # item, then the parent that passes that Power item's stat down is chosen
  184       # randomly)
  185       power_items = [
  186         [:POWERWEIGHT, :HP],
  187         [:POWERBRACER, :ATTACK],
  188         [:POWERBELT,   :DEFENSE],
  189         [:POWERLENS,   :SPECIAL_ATTACK],
  190         [:POWERBAND,   :SPECIAL_DEFENSE],
  191         [:POWERANKLET, :SPEED]
  192       ]
  193       power_stats = {}
  194       [mother, father].each do |parent|
  195         power_items.each do |item|
  196           next if !parent.hasItem?(item[0])
  197           power_stats[item[1]] ||= []
  198           power_stats[item[1]].push(parent.iv[item[1]])
  199           break
  200         end
  201       end
  202       power_stats.each_pair do |stat, new_stats|
  203         next if !new_stats || new_stats.length == 0
  204         new_stat = new_stats.sample
  205         egg.iv[stat] = new_stat
  206         stats.delete(stat)   # Don't try to inherit this stat's IV again
  207         inherit_count -= 1
  208       end
  209       # Inherit the rest of the IVs
  210       chosen_stats = stats.sample(inherit_count)
  211       chosen_stats.each { |stat| egg.iv[stat] = [mother, father].sample.iv[stat] }
  212     end
  213 
  214     # Poké Balls can only be inherited from parents that are related to the
  215     # egg's species.
  216     # NOTE: This is how Poké Ball inheritance works in Gen 7+. Gens 5 and lower
  217     #       don't have Poké Ball inheritance at all. In Gen 6, only a female
  218     #       parent can pass down its Poké Ball. I don't think it's worth adding
  219     #       in these variations on the mechanic.
  220     # NOTE: The official games treat Nidoran M/F and Volbeat/Illumise as
  221     #       unrelated for the purpose of this mechanic. Essentials treats them
  222     #       as related and allows them to pass down their Poké Balls.
  223     def inherit_poke_ball(egg, mother, father)
  224       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
  225       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
  226       balls = []
  227       [mother, father].each do |parent|
  228         balls.push(parent[0].poke_ball) if parent[2]
  229       end
  230       balls.delete(:MASTERBALL)    # Can't inherit this Ball
  231       balls.delete(:CHERISHBALL)   # Can't inherit this Ball
  232       egg.poke_ball = balls.sample if !balls.empty?
  233     end
  234 
  235     # NOTE: There is a bug in Gen 8 that skips the original generation of an
  236     #       egg's personal ID if the Masuda Method/Shiny Charm can cause any
  237     #       rerolls. Essentials doesn't have this bug, meaning eggs are slightly
  238     #       more likely to be shiny (in Gen 8+ mechanics) than in Gen 8 itself.
  239     def set_shininess(egg, mother, father)
  240       shiny_retries = 0
  241       if father.owner.language != mother.owner.language
  242         shiny_retries += (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8) ? 6 : 5
  243       end
  244       shiny_retries += 2 if $bag.has?(:SHINYCHARM)
  245       return if shiny_retries == 0
  246       shiny_retries.times do
  247         break if egg.shiny?
  248         egg.shiny = nil   # Make it recalculate shininess
  249         egg.personalID = rand(2**16) | (rand(2**16) << 16)
  250       end
  251     end
  252 
  253     def set_pokerus(egg)
  254       egg.givePokerus if rand(65_536) < Settings::POKERUS_CHANCE
  255     end
  256   end

  482       commands.push(_INTL("CANCEL"))
  483       command = pbMessage(message, commands, commands.length)

  492     raise _INTL("No room in party for egg.") if $player.party_full?

  501   def pokemon_pair
  502     pkmn1 = nil
  503     pkmn2 = nil
  504     @slots.each do |slot|
  505       next if !slot.filled?
  506       if pkmn1.nil?
  507         pkmn1 = slot.pokemon
  508       else
  509         pkmn2 = slot.pokemon
  510       end
  511     end
  512     raise _INTL("Couldn't find 2 deposited Pokémon.") if pkmn2.nil?
  513     return pkmn1, pkmn2

  516   def pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn)
  517     return pkmn.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)
  518   end

  520   def compatible_gender?(pkmn1, pkmn2)
  521     return true if pkmn1.female? && pkmn2.male?
  522     return true if pkmn1.male? && pkmn2.female?
  523     ditto1 = pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn1)
  524     ditto2 = pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn2)
  525     return true if ditto1 && !ditto2
  526     return true if ditto2 && !ditto1
  527     return false
  528   end

  530   def compatibility
  531     return 0 if self.count != 2
  532     # Find the Pokémon whose compatibility is being calculated
  533     pkmn1, pkmn2 = pokemon_pair
  534     # Shadow Pokémon cannot breed
  535     return 0 if pkmn1.shadowPokemon? || pkmn2.shadowPokemon?
  536     # Pokémon in the Undiscovered egg group cannot breed
  537     egg_groups1 = pkmn1.species_data.egg_groups
  538     egg_groups2 = pkmn2.species_data.egg_groups
  539     return 0 if egg_groups1.include?(:Undiscovered) ||
  540                 egg_groups2.include?(:Undiscovered)
  541     # Pokémon that don't share an egg group (and neither is in the Ditto group)
  542     # cannot breed
  543     return 0 if !egg_groups1.include?(:Ditto) &&
  544                 !egg_groups2.include?(:Ditto) &&
  545                 (egg_groups1 & egg_groups2).length == 0
  546     # Pokémon with incompatible genders cannot breed
  547     return 0 if !compatible_gender?(pkmn1, pkmn2)
  548     # Pokémon can breed; calculate a compatibility factor
  549     ret = 1
  550     ret += 1 if pkmn1.species == pkmn2.species
  551     ret += 1 if pkmn1.owner.id != pkmn2.owner.id
  552     return ret
  553   end

  138   # Download all gifts from online

  149     t = []

  158     # Gift chosen
  159     if command == -1 || command == commands.length - 1   # Cancel
  160       break
  161     elsif command == commands.length - 2   # Export selected to file
  162       begin
  163         newfile = []

  174     elsif command >= 0 && command < commands.length - 2   # A gift

  331 def pbMysteryGiftEncrypt(gift)
  332   ret = [Zlib::Deflate.deflate(Marshal.dump(gift))].pack("m")
  333   return ret
  334 end

  336 def pbMysteryGiftDecrypt(gift)
  337   return [] if nil_or_empty?(gift)
  338   ret = Marshal.restore(Zlib::Inflate.inflate(gift.unpack("m")[0]))
  339   if ret
  340     ret.each do |gft|
  341       if gft[1] == 0   # Pokémon
  342         gft[2] = gft[2]
  343       else   # Item
  344         gft[2] = GameData::Item.get(gft[2]).id
  345       end
  346     end
  347   end
  348   return ret
  349 end

  385       $player.mystery_gifts[index] = [id]

   85 #===============================================================================
   86 # Generate a full team's worth of Pokémon which obey the given rules.
   87 #===============================================================================
   88 def pbBattleFactoryPokemon(rules, win_count, swap_count, rentals)
   89   btpokemon = pbGetBTPokemon(pbBattleChallenge.currentChallenge)
   90   level = rules.ruleset.suggestedLevel
   91   pokemonNumbers = [0, 0]   # Start and end indices in btpokemon
   92   ivs = [0, 0]   # Lower and higher IV values for Pokémon to use
   93   iv_threshold = 6   # Number of Pokémon that use the lower IV
   94   set = [win_count / 7, 7].min   # The set of 7 battles win_count is part of (minus 1)
   95   # Choose a range of Pokémon in btpokemon to randomly select from. The higher
   96   # the set number, the later the range lies within btpokemon (typically).
   97   # This table's start point and end point values are based on a btpokemon size
   98   # of 881. They are scaled based on the actual size of btpokemon.
   99   # Group 1 is 0 - 173. Group 2 is 174 - 371. Group 3 is 372 - 881.
  100   if level == GameData::GrowthRate.max_level   # Open Level (Level 100)
  101     table = [
  102       [372, 491],   # Group 3 (first quarter)
  103       [492, 610],   # Group 3 (second quarter)
  104       [611, 729],   # Group 3 (third quarter)
  105       [730, 849],   # Group 3 (fourth quarter)
  106       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
  107       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
  108       [372, 881],   # All of Group 3
  109       [372, 881]    # This line is used for all higher sets (all of Group 3)
  110     ]
  111   else
  112     table = [
  113       [  0, 173],   # Group 1
  114       [174, 272],   # Group 2 (first half)
  115       [273, 371],   # Group 2 (second half)
  116       [372, 491],   # Group 3 (first quarter)
  117       [492, 610],   # Group 3 (second quarter)
  118       [611, 729],   # Group 3 (third quarter)
  119       [730, 849],   # Group 3 (fourth quarter)
  120       [372, 881]    # This line is used for all higher sets (all of Group 3)
  121     ]
  122   end
  123   pokemonNumbers[0] = table[set][0] * btpokemon.length / 881
  124   pokemonNumbers[1] = table[set][1] * btpokemon.length / 881
  125   # Choose two IV values for Pokémon to use (the one for the current set, and
  126   # the one for the next set). The iv_threshold below determines which of these
  127   # two values a given Pokémon uses. The higher the set number, the higher these
  128   # values are.
  129   ivtable = [3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 21, 31, 31]   # Last value is used for all higher sets
  130   ivs = [ivtable[set], ivtable[[set + 1, 7].min]]
  131   # Choose a threshold, which is the number of Pokémon with the lower IV out of
  132   # the two chosen above. The higher the swap_count, the lower this threshold
  133   # (i.e. the more Pokémon will have the higher IV).
  134   thresholds = [   # Each value is [minimum swap count, threshold value]
  135     [ 0, 6],
  136     [15, 5],
  137     [22, 4],
  138     [29, 3],
  139     [36, 2],
  140     [43, 1]
  141   ]
  142   thresholds.each { |val| iv_threshold = val[1] if swap_count >= val[0] }
  143   # Randomly choose Pokémon from the range to fill the party with
  144   old_min = rules.ruleset.minLength
  145   old_max = rules.ruleset.maxLength
  146   if rentals.length == 0
  147     rules.ruleset.setNumber(6)   # Rentals
  148   else
  149     rules.ruleset.setNumber(old_max + rentals.length)   # Opponent
  150   end
  151   party = []
  152   loop do
  153     party.clear
  154     while party.length < ((rentals.length == 0) ? 6 : old_max)
  155       rnd = pokemonNumbers[0] + rand(pokemonNumbers[1] - pokemonNumbers[0] + 1)
  156       rndpoke = btpokemon[rnd]
  157       indvalue = (party.length < iv_threshold) ? ivs[0] : ivs[1]
  158       party.push(rndpoke.createPokemon(level, indvalue, nil))
  159     end
  160     break if rules.ruleset.isValid?([].concat(party).concat(rentals))
  161   end
  162   rules.ruleset.setNumberRange(old_min, old_max)
  163   return party
  164 end

   20     defense = baseStats[:DEFENSE]
   21     spAtk   = baseStats[:SPECIAL_ATTACK]
   22     spDef   = baseStats[:SPECIAL_DEFENSE]
   23     speed   = baseStats[:SPEED]
   24     @type  = species_data.types[0]
   25     @type  = species_data.types[1] if @type == :NORMAL && species_data.types[1]
   26     @west  = baseStatToValue(attack + (speed / 3))
   27     @east  = baseStatToValue(defense + (hp / 3))
   28     @north = baseStatToValue(spAtk + (speed / 3))
   29     @south = baseStatToValue(spDef + (hp / 3))

   32   def baseStatToValue(stat)
   33     return 10 if stat >= 189
   34     return 9 if stat >= 160
   35     return 8 if stat >= 134
   36     return 7 if stat >= 115
   37     return 6 if stat >= 100
   38     return 5 if stat >= 86
   39     return 4 if stat >= 73
   40     return 3 if stat >= 60
   41     return 2 if stat >= 45
   42     return 1
   43   end

   46     return [@west, @east, @north, @south][panel]

   53   def bonus(opponent)
   54     effectiveness = Effectiveness.calculate(@type, opponent.type)
   55     if Effectiveness.ineffective?(effectiveness)
   56       return -2
   57     elsif Effectiveness.not_very_effective?(effectiveness)
   58       return -1
   59     elsif Effectiveness.super_effective?(effectiveness)
   60       return 1
   61     end
   62     return 0
   63   end

   65   def price
   66     maxValue = [@north, @east, @south, @west].max
   67     ret = (@north * @north) + (@east * @east) + (@south * @south) + (@west * @west)
   68     ret += maxValue * maxValue * 2
   69     ret *= maxValue
   70     ret *= (@north + @east + @south + @west)
   71     ret /= 10   # Ranges from 2 to 24,000
   72     # Quantize prices to the next highest "unit"
   73     if ret > 10_000
   74       ret = (1 + (ret / 1000)) * 1000
   75     elsif ret > 5000
   76       ret = (1 + (ret / 500)) * 500
   77     elsif ret > 1000
   78       ret = (1 + (ret / 100)) * 100
   79     elsif ret > 500
   80       ret = (1 + (ret / 50)) * 50
   81     else
   82       ret = (1 + (ret / 10)) * 10
   83     end
   84     return ret
   85   end

  647   def flipBoard(x, y, attackerParam = nil, recurse = false)
  648     panels = [x - 1, y, x + 1, y, x, y - 1, x, y + 1]
  649     panels[0] = (@wrapAround ? @width - 1 : 0) if panels[0] < 0            # left
  650     panels[2] = (@wrapAround ? 0 : @width - 1) if panels[2] > @width - 1     # right
  651     panels[5] = (@wrapAround ? @height - 1 : 0) if panels[5] < 0           # top
  652     panels[7] = (@wrapAround ? 0 : @height - 1) if panels[7] > @height - 1   # bottom
  653     attacker = attackerParam.nil? ? @board[(y * @width) + x] : attackerParam
  654     flips = []
  655     return nil if attackerParam && @board[(y * @width) + x].owner != 0
  656     return nil if !attacker.card || attacker.owner == 0
  657     4.times do |i|
  658       defenderX = panels[i * 2]
  659       defenderY = panels[(i * 2) + 1]
  660       defender  = @board[(defenderY * @width) + defenderX]
  661       next if !defender.card
  662       if attacker.owner != defender.owner
  663         attack  = attacker.attack(i)
  664         defense = defender.defense(i)
  665         if @elements
  666           # If attacker's type matches the tile's element, add
  667           # a bonus of 1 (only for original attacker, not combos)
  668           attack += 1 if !recurse && attacker.type == attacker.card.type
  669         else
  670           # Modifier depends on opponent's Pokémon type:
  671           # +1 - Super effective
  672           # -1 - Not very effective
  673           # -2 - Immune
  674 #         attack += attacker.bonus(defender)
  675         end
  676         if attack > defense || (attack == defense && @sameWins)
  677           flips.push([defenderX, defenderY])
  678           if attackerParam.nil?
  679             defender.owner = attacker.owner
  680             if @sameWins
  681               # Combo with the "sameWins" rule
  682               ret = flipBoard(defenderX, defenderY, nil, true)
  683               flips.concat(ret) if ret
  684             end
  685           else
  686             if @sameWins
  687               # Combo with the "sameWins" rule
  688               ret = flipBoard(defenderX, defenderY, attackerParam, true)
  689               flips.concat(ret) if ret
  690             end
  691           end
  692         end
  693       end
  694     end
  695     return flips
  696   end

  150   def pbGetRelearnableMoves(pkmn)
  151     return [] if !pkmn || pkmn.egg? || pkmn.shadowPokemon?
  152     moves = []
  153     pkmn.getMoveList.each do |m|
  154       next if m[0] > pkmn.level || pkmn.hasMove?(m[1])
  155       moves.push(m[1]) if !moves.include?(m[1])
  156     end
  157     if Settings::MOVE_RELEARNER_CAN_TEACH_MORE_MOVES && pkmn.first_moves
  158       tmoves = []
  159       pkmn.first_moves.each do |i|
  160         tmoves.push(i) if !moves.include?(i) && !pkmn.hasMove?(i)
  161       end
  162       moves = tmoves + moves   # List first moves before level-up moves
  163     end
  164     return moves | []   # remove duplicates
  165   end

  634     knowable_moves = knowable_moves.reverse

  638     first_move_index = 0 if first_move_index < 0
  639     (first_move_index...knowable_moves.length).each do |i|

  649     # Check if self already knows the move; if so, move it to the end of the array

  652       @moves.push(m)
  653       @moves.delete_at(i)

  164 #===============================================================================
  165 # Target drops its item. It regains the item at the end of the battle. (Knock Off)
  166 # If target has a losable item, damage is multiplied by 1.5.
  167 #===============================================================================
  168 class Battle::Move::RemoveTargetItem < Battle::Move
  169   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  170     if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 &&
  171        target.item && !target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  172       # NOTE: Damage is still boosted even if target has Sticky Hold or a
  173       #       substitute.
  174       baseDmg = (baseDmg * 1.5).round
  175     end
  176     return baseDmg
  177   end
  178 
  179   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  180     return if user.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't knock off
  181     return if user.fainted?
  182     return if target.damageState.unaffected || target.damageState.substitute
  183     return if !target.item || target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  184     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  185     itemName = target.itemName
  186     target.pbRemoveItem(false)
  187     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} dropped its {2}!", target.pbThis, itemName))
  188   end
  189 end

  196     return if target.damageState.substitute || target.damageState.berryWeakened
  197     return if !target.item || (!target.item.is_berry? &&
